Who We Are 

 Baton is Ryder ’s in-house product development group focused on harnessing emerging technologies to redefine transportation and logistics. With $10B in freight under management, our technology reaches every part of the U.S. economy.

 We design and ship category-defining software that enables Ryder and its 50,000+ customers—including some of the world’s most well-known brands—to plan and execute freight intelligently, efficiently, and cost-effectively. Our work includes everything from customer-facing software to the data platform that will power the next era of innovation at Ryder.

 Baton’s mission : enable supply chain on autopilot.

 Ryder acquired Baton in 2022 to power its next wave of digital products. We operate at startup speed, with Fortune 500 reach. If you have a passion for solving complex problems and creating impact for the engine of the American economy, you’ll love it here.

 Role: Software Engineer 
 Department: Data Platform
 Location Hayes Valley, San Francisco, CA

 Basic Job Details 

 Job Type: Full Time
 Work Model: Hybrid
 Remote Days: Monday & Friday
 Office Days: Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday

 Job Description 

 As a Software Engineer on our Data Platform team, you will design, build, and maintain the core data infrastructure that powers Baton's near real-time streaming platform. You'll own data pipelines end to end from ingestion through processing to consumption, and work closely with data stakeholders across engineering, product, and ML to translate complex data challenges into scalable, maintainable solutions.

 Baton's data platform is the backbone of intelligent freight operations at Ryder scale, and this role exists to accelerate its growth. You'll take ownership of our streaming and messaging architecture, contribute to data model development, and refine the API layers that surface data across the organization. Working within a high-trust, high-autonomy team, you'll move fast, operate in production from day one, and build systems that directly impact how Ryder and its 50,000+ customers plan and execute freight.

 Responsibilities 

 Design and maintain a robust data streaming and messaging architecture.

 Ownership of our near real-time data streaming platform.

 Act as a technical liaison to ensure alignment of data strategies with business goals.

 Take charge of the entire data landscape, encompassing near real-time data ingestion, sophisticated processing, and efficient data consumption strategies.

 Collaborate closely with data stakeholders to simplify and solve complex data challenges, transforming them into scalable and maintainable technical solutions.

 Everything from developing and maintaining data pipelines, enhancing data models, to refining API layers.

 Required Qualifications 

 Data Systems Expertise 

 Demonstrates experience with real-time data systems

 Relational table modeling and Event driven pipeline architecture

 Working familiarity with SQL: Query Performance Analysis, Optimization, and Construction

 Python Proficiency 

 Advanced proficiency coding in python

 Preferred Qualifications 

 Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field

 3-5 years of Software Engineering experience, with a preference for backgrounds in event-driven architecture or real-time data streaming

 Demonstrated interest or experience in the freight and logistics industry, with a keen understanding of its data-driven challenges and opportunities.

 Strong foundation in data analytics and big data technologies, with the ability to leverage these skills to drive insights and operational efficiencies.

 The Perks 

 Competitive Base Salary

 Annual Company Bonus

 Long Term Cash Incentive Plan

 401k with Matching

 Hybrid Work Schedule

 Comprehensive Health Coverage

 Hyper-Stable, publicly traded Enterprise

 Employee Stock Purchase Program (15% discount to market value)

 Collaborative, Tech-Forward, Cozy office environment in Hayes Valley

 Compensation Range: The annual base salary range for this position is $162,000 - $216,000*

 Compensation will vary based on factors including skill level, transferable knowledge, and experience.
Note that the above is not the representation of total compensation, which includes our LTI Package as well.
In addition to base salary, Baton's full-time employees are eligible for an annual company performance bonuses.

 Why You Should Join 

 Have an immediate impact: 

 With Ryder’s existing customer base of 50,000+ companies and an internal headcount of 43,000, the scale and impact of our products will be large and far-reaching, from day one.

 Opportunity to grow and lead in a Fortune 500 company: 

 You’ll get to work in a rapidly growing, startup-like environment while having the stability and backing of Ryder and its full executive team.

Who We Are & Why Join Us 

 Avathon is the leading Industrial AI autonomy platform, helping customers across heavy industries -- energy, mining, manufacturing, aerospace, defense, and logistics -- accelerate the journey toward autonomous operations. Our platform is built on a Computational Knowledge Graph foundation that contextualizes and connects operational data across siloed systems, bringing together time series, structured, unstructured, and machine vision data to power AI-driven applications in asset performance management, supply chain intelligence, visual AI, and global trade management. With capabilities spanning digital twins, normal behavior modeling, natural language processing, and computer vision, Avathon delivers real-time predictive intelligence and agentic decision-making at industrial scale.

 Cutting-Edge AI Innovation -- Join a team at the forefront of AI, developing groundbreaking solutions that shape the future. High-Growth Environment -- Thrive in a fast-scaling startup where agility, collaboration, and rapid professional growth are the norm. Meaningful Impact -- Work on AI-driven projects that drive real change across industries and improve lives.

 Learn more at: avathon.com 

 Who We Are & Why Join Us 

 Avathon is the leading Industrial AI autonomy platform, helping customers across heavy industries - energy, mining, manufacturing, aerospace, defense, and logistics - accelerate the journey toward autonomous operations. Our platform is built on a Computational Knowledge Graph foundation that contextualizes and connects operational data across siloed systems, bringing together time series, structured, unstructured, and machine vision data to power AI-driven applications in asset performance management, supply chain intelligence, visual AI, and global trade management. With capabilities spanning digital twins, normal behavior modeling, natural language processing, and computer vision, Avathon delivers real-time predictive intelligence and agentic decision-making at industrial scale.

 Cutting-Edge AI Innovation - Join a team at the forefront of AI, developing groundbreaking solutions that shape the future. High-Growth Environment - Thrive in a fast-scaling startup where agility, collaboration, and rapid professional growth are the norm. Meaningful Impact - Work on AI-driven projects that drive real change across industries and improve lives.

 About the Role

 We’re hiring a Database Developer / Lead Database Engineer at Avathon – where AI meets the real world.

 This is a high-impact role at the intersection of low-level systems programming, distributed storage, and query engine optimization, focused on building core database technology ground-up rather than application-level software.

 We are looking for an experienced Database Engineer to lead the architecture, design, and deployment of engine-level database systems across high-performance, large-scale environments. You will tackle real-world storage challenges involving distributed consensus, transaction isolation, custom indexing, and high-throughput query processing across multi-model architectures.

 This role offers the opportunity to drive innovation in storage engine design, graph processing, distributed execution, and system reliability, while collaborating closely with engineering and product teams to bring resilient, production-grade database systems into reality.

 Core Responsibilities

 Architecture & Engine Design

 Storage Engines: Design and implement storage layers using LSM Trees, B-Trees, RocksDB, LevelDB, LMDB, WiredTiger, or custom engines.

 Storage & Indexing: Build efficient key-value storage layouts, secondary/composite indexes, inverted indexes, spatial indexes, and vector indexes.

 Data Iteration: Design high-throughput pagination, cursor mechanics, and large-scale dataset iteration patterns.

 Performance Tuning: Optimize write/read amplification, compaction strategies, caching layers, and Bloom filters.

 Distributed Systems & Reliability

 Consensus & Sharding: Implement Raft or Paxos consensus, data partitioning/sharding strategies, and multi-node replication.

 Fault Tolerance: Architect resilient systems capable of automated leader election, failure recovery, dynamic retries, and partition handling.

 Platform Operations: Integrate service discovery (etcd, Consul, ZooKeeper), distributed tracing/observability, zero-downtime rolling upgrades, back-ups, and storage format compatibility layers.

 Concurrency, Transactions & Query Execution

 Transaction Control: Work with MVCC, Snapshot Isolation, Optimistic Concurrency Control (OCC), and Two-Phase Locking (2PL).

 Crash Recovery: Implement WAL (Write-Ahead Logging), crash recovery guarantees, deadlock detection, and distributed transactions (2PC).

 Query Optimization: Build and optimize query execution plans, join algorithms, predicate pushdowns, and distributed query execution pipelines.

 Quality, Testing & Systems Engineering

 Low-Level Development: Write production-grade C++17/20, Rust, Java, or Scala code focused on low-overhead memory management, profiling, and benchmarking.

 Validation & Testing: Ensure transactional correctness and data integrity via distributed fault injection, property-based testing, and consistency validation suites.

 Technical Qualifications

 Graph Database Experience (Highly Preferred)

 Hands-on experience with JanusGraph/Titan, Neo4j, TigerGraph, Amazon Neptune, Dgraph, or a custom in-house graph engine.

 Strong understanding of graph storage models, traversal algorithms, graph indexing, and distributed graph processing.

 Familiarity with graph query languages such as Gremlin, Cypher, SPARQL, or SQL/PGQ.

 Specialized Indexing

 Vector Search: HNSW, IVF, ANN techniques.

 Spatial Indexing: R-Tree, H3, S2, Geohash.

 Search & Composite: Inverted indexes, full-text search, and multi-column composite structures.

 Engineering & Systems Core

 Languages: C++17/20 or Rust (systems level); Java or Scala (distributed services).

 Systems Skills: Deep experience with performance profiling, memory management, low-level debugging, and automated benchmarking.

 Lead Engineer Expectations

 Candidates applying for Senior or Lead designations will also be expected to: 

 Lead technical design, write RFCs/design docs, and establish system architecture.

 Mentor engineers, conduct thorough code reviews, and drive technical standards.

 Deconstruct complex engine initiatives into structured milestone roadmaps.

 Spearhead production incident investigations and root-cause analysis (RCA).

 Nice to Have

 Active open-source contributions to database, storage, or graph projects.

 Familiarity with foundational research papers (e.g., Spanner, Dynamo, Percolator, Calvin, Aurora, TAO, Pregel).

 Experience with change data capture (CDC), streaming systems, or materialized view maintenance.

 Background in compiler design, query language parser generation, or multi-model engine design (Graph, Vector, Document, Time-Series).

 Avathon is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, pregnancy, genetic information, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected category under applicable federal, state, and local laws.

jobs.title: Principal Data Engineer
jobs.description:
An AI-first global organization operating in a fast-paced environment requires a central data engineering engine, and this role serves that need by using Agile methodologies to architect highly scalable, secure, and reliable enterprise data platforms. As a Principal Data Engineer (IC5), you will drive substantial impact on the division’s reputation and technical effectiveness, independently assessing complex scenarios to develop the methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria for obtaining mission-critical results. You will provide deep expertise in cloud data infrastructure and pipeline architecture across GTM, Product, CX, Finance, Legal, and People domains, making critical architectural decisions within broadly defined AI first best practices. Operating as a highly visible technical leader, you will facilitate collaboration across employees, clients, and senior executives to deliver scalable data solutions before the business even asks for them.

 Responsibilities 

 Formulate and execute the technical architecture strategy for global ETL/ELT pipelines, streaming frameworks (such as AWS Kafka), and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) deployments to support enterprise-wide AI/ML initiatives.

 Serve as the principal technical authority for the data engineering work group, establishing development standards, code review practices, and evaluation criteria to ensure high pipeline availability and data freshness.

 Architect, deploy, and maintain autonomous AI agents (e.g., Finance Analyst, Data Analyst agents) utilizing LLMs like Claude and Gemini, integrating them directly into the modern data stack for automated insights.

 Independently assess high-risk architectural challenges across GTM, Finance, Product, and other operational domains, making definitive decisions on data warehousing design, upstream schema drift mitigation, and data lake scalability.

 Partner with IT, Security, and Product infrastructure teams on highly specialized governance and architecture matters, including data asset correlation, normalization of disparate source schemas, and the enforcement of global RBAC and PII data masking standards.

 Implement automated data pipeline monitoring, alerting, and automated cleansing mechanisms at the ingestion tier to proactively isolate and fix broken fields or source schema drifts.

 Partner with Analytics Engineering to ensure the stability, scalability, and optimal performance of underlying production-ready repositories feeding the enterprise semantic layer.

 Minimum Qualifications 

 10+ years of experience in data engineering, cloud data architecture, or specialized infrastructure roles, with a proven track record of delivering technical leadership for engineering work groups.

 Advanced proficiency in SQL and software engineering programming languages, specifically Python, for pipeline automation, data scripting, and AI agent orchestration frameworks.

 Extensive experience designing, provisioning, and tuning production-grade cloud environments using Terraform to manage complex warehouse and networking configurations.

 Proven experience independently architecting real-time streaming topologies, high-volume event data ingestions, and custom API-driven connector/adapter frameworks.

 Preferred Qualifications 

 Experience delivering data infrastructure iteratively within a fast-paced environment utilizing Agile management tools like Jira.

 Strong hands-on expertise architecting, optimizing, and managing multi-cluster enterprise data warehouses specifically within Snowflake.

 Background managing cross-functional technical data requirements and standardizing architectures across GTM, Finance, Product, CX, Legal, and People divisions.

 Deep experience designing and scaling advanced data platform solutions optimized for machine learning training pipelines, Vector DBs, and operational AI consumption.

 Experience creating organizational methods, techniques, and governance frameworks to automate data cleansing, quality monitoring, and system resilience at scale.

 Experience deploying and managing multi-region cloud data infrastructure architectures within AWS enterprise environments.

About us 

 AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

 About BEES 

 Join us to build the future of B2B commerce!

 BEES is AB InBev’s B2B platform. Through our ecosystem, merchants and retailers across 29 countries can stock their businesses quickly, easily, and securely. At BEES, we dream big, lead with purpose, and develop technology that transforms the way retailers and sellers grow.

 Every line of code and every partnership is built in service of a single mission: to make commerce better for retailers and sellers around the world. Here, your work is not just important. It makes a difference!

 What you'll do: 

 Own the technical design and delivery of the data model for a BEES business domain. Start from business intent and from the data sources that exist, and produce authoritative definitions for entities, assets, attributes, relationships, identifiers, and grain.

 Profile source systems and Unity Catalog tables (grain, keys, cardinality, overlap, nulls, and how columns are derived) and decide which sources can support a trustworthy representation of the business.

 Produce and evolve the domain's canonical logical model and canonical datasets, including identifiers, relationships, and cardinalities. Map attributes to physical columns, with transformation, nullability, and lineage documented so consumers can trust the result.

 Design master-data outcomes for the domain, including entity resolution: match approach, blocking keys, duplicate handling, cross-system identity, and survivorship when sources disagree.

 Define advanced data-quality expectations on the model (uniqueness at the declared grain, referential integrity, completeness, validity, consistency across sources, reconciliation, and freshness) and contribute to the Data Quality Framework and Tooling so those expectations become executable checks and monitoring.

 Shape the model for its consumers. Data scientists and data analysts are the primary consumers. The same model feeds downstream data products such as curated tables, metric views, and feature tables, with a stable grain and documented semantics.

 Contribute to the ontology codebase: Python packages, SQL and Spark on Databricks, YAML definition contracts, entity classification, lineage-aware mappings, and tests. Review pull requests on models, mappings, and ontology-aligned dataset changes.

 Drive entity and attribute lifecycle work: creation, change, split, rename, deprecation, and retirement, with compatibility guidance and clear communication to consumers.

 Escalate cross-domain conflicts or ownership disputes when broader alignment is required.

 Mentor engineers on the team through design review, source-analysis pairing, and hands-on support

 What you'll need: 

 Senior experience as a data engineer, data analyst, or any equivalent role in data, who has designed conceptual and logical data models from operational source systems in a complex business.

 A record of turning ambiguous business context and imperfect data into a model with explicit entities, grain, keys, relationships, and cardinalities that downstream teams actually use.

 Hands-on master data management, including entity resolution: deterministic and probabilistic matching, blocking, duplicate detection, golden-record or survivorship rules, and identity across systems.

 Advanced data quality technique. You have designed and applied uniqueness, referential integrity, validity, completeness, consistency, reconciliation, and timeliness checks, and you have seen them catch real defects before consumers did. SQL, Python, or a quality framework in production counts.

 Traditional data engineering: production SQL (joins, aggregations, window functions), batch ELT patterns, and enough PySpark or Spark SQL to profile a source and prototype a conformed dataset on Databricks.

 Ability to contribute to a Python codebase: change an existing package, add a test, and carry a pull request through review. Our stack is Python 3.11+, Databricks (Unity Catalog and Delta), SQL, and YAML contracts in Git.

 Experience with catalog or metadata systems, mapping business attributes onto physical tables and columns, lineage, and data contracts between producers and consumers.

 Experience reviewing other engineers' models and code, and mentoring through design feedback and documentation.

 Collaboration in GitHub or Azure DevOps, including review of changes from outside the immediate team.

 Clear written and verbal communication with business stakeholders, data scientists, and data analysts. Definitions should be usable without a meeting.

 Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or another quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.

 Nice to have: 

 Relevant data management and governance experience: business glossaries, critical data elements, stewardship, naming standards, and dataset certification. The team will teach the ontology vocabulary.

 Prior work on Azure Databricks or Unity Catalog.

 Experience preparing data for data scientists or analysts: feature grain, metric grain, slowly changing attributes, or point-in-time correctness.

 Exposure to entity classification, schema matching, or duplication discovery across a large table estate.

 Prior experience in a marketplace, B2B, or B2C company.

 More about you: 

 You own the model for your domain after it ships: you answer consumer questions, and you change the definition when the data or the business shows it is wrong.

 You trust a model after you have looked at the data, and you can show the grain, the key, and the source behind a definition.

 You care that a data scientist or a data analyst can use an entity without reverse-engineering the source system.

 You treat identifiers, match rules, and grain as product decisions, because a wrong key breaks quality, metrics, and downstream products together.

 You write definitions, mappings, and quality expectations that another engineer can implement.

 You raise the bar through review, documentation, and practical mentorship.

 You balance delivery urgency with compatibility when an entity that consumers already use has to change.

 About the Role: 

 As a Staff Full Stack Engineer (Backend Focus), you will build and operate the backend of a Web Analytics and AI portal. That includes the APIs that serve the application, the read data layer over analytical data, authentication and authorization, and the integration points with the services the rest of the team builds. The portal gives commercial intelligence to the people who make business decisions, through daily briefings, customizable KPIs, analytical insights, geographic exploration, and conversational analytics.

 This is a Staff (L6), hands-on individual contributor role on a lean team where everyone is Staff: a Staff Architect, Staff AI Engineers, Staff Software Engineers, and Data Engineers. Architectural direction sits with the Staff Architect, and the AI Engineers own the agents. You are the builder: you take features from the design doc to production, end to end, and you make them fast, observable, and reliable. Most of your time goes to writing, reviewing, and operating code, including the user interface when the delivery calls for it.

 What you'll do: 

 Build the backend and ship features end to end 

 Design, implement, test, and operate backend services against explicit latency, availability, and cost targets.

 Implement typed, versioned API contracts and evolve them without breaking clients.

 Own authentication, authorization, and multi-tenant access control across the portal.

 Ship features end to end, from the API to the interface, when the delivery calls for it.

 Integrate the application with internal services, including the agent services built by the AI Engineers. This covers response streaming, timeouts, cancellation, and partial failures.

 Own the read path and performance 

 Own the read path over analytical data: data modeling, query plans, pagination, batching, caching, and consistency trade-offs.

 Set and defend performance budgets. Profile services, reduce tail latency (p95, p99), and optimize cost per request.

 Run load and capacity tests before launches, and use the results to make design decisions.

 Make systems observable and reliable 

 Instrument services with metrics, structured logs, and distributed tracing from day one.

 Define SLIs and SLOs, alerts, and dashboards for the components you own, and take part in on-call.

 Diagnose and fix reliability issues, and lead incident response and blameless postmortems.

 Establish safe rollout practices: feature flags, canary releases, and fast rollback.

 Design and raise the bar 

 Write design docs for the components you deliver, compare alternatives with data and prototypes, and escalate risk to the Staff Architect.

 Raise the team's technical bar through code review, pairing, and standards for testing, observability, and safe rollout.

 Use coding agent harnesses such as Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex as part of your workflow, and review generated code against tests, types, and contracts.

 What you'll need: 

 Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or another quantitative field. A master's degree or PhD is a plus.

 A track record of building features end-to-end and owning them in production.

 Relevant experience in software design for reliability and scale, on both new and existing systems.

 Deep command of at least one high-performance language, such as Java/Kotlin, Go, Rust, C++, or C#, including its memory model, concurrency model, and runtime.

 Hands-on experience with observability in production: metrics, tracing, logging, SLOs, and tools such as OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Grafana, or Prometheus.

 Proven experience with performance work: profiling, query optimization, caching strategies, and load testing.

 Production depth in distributed systems: timeouts, retries, idempotency, partial failure, streaming (SSE, WebSockets), and decisions based on tail latency (p95, p99).

jobs.title: Lead AI Architect - Data Platform
jobs.description:
Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. With a buy-grow-and-hold-for-life approach and a permanent capital base, Banyan acquires and grows companies worldwide, honoring founder legacies and helping portfolio companies modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. Founded in 2016, Banyan operates more than 120 portfolio companies across North and South America, Europe, and APAC, and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list for six consecutive years. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world.

 The Role

 We are hiring our first Lead AI Architect to design, build, and run the centralized data and AI platform that powers Banyan. The cornerstone of the work is a centralized data model, a Banyan data lake, that consolidates the data we already have and unlocks safe AI experimentation for our internal functional teams: Finance, M&A, Business Development, and others.

 This role is modeled on a classical Enterprise Architect role and adapted for an AI-first world. You will set the target-state architecture, choose the patterns we standardize on, write code yourself, and own the result. You will partner with our embedded business analysts and the leaders of each functional vertical so the platform stays grounded in real use cases, not abstractions.

 This is a player-coach role. You start hands-on. Over time you build and lead a small platform team.

 What You Will Build

 A centralized data lake on AWS: the single, governed source of truth for internal Banyan data. Designed for analytics, ML, and AI experimentation.

 A reference architecture for AI: patterns and building blocks our verticals use to go from idea to safe production: model selection, RAG, evaluation, observability, cost controls.

 Guardrails that make experimentation safe: data classification, access tiering, sandboxes, audit logging, and clear rules for what can be sent where.

 A platform team and operating model: the team, standards, and rituals that keep the platform reliable and improving as adoption grows.

 What You Will Do

 Define and own the target-state data and AI architecture for Banyan. Make the trade-offs explicit and write them down.

 Design and build the AWS-centric data lake. Set the patterns for storage, cataloging, query, ingestion, modeling, and lineage. Likely stack: S3, Glue, Lake Formation, Athena, Redshift, Iceberg or similar open table formats, plus Terraform or CDK for infrastructure as code.

 Stand up the AI experimentation layer: model access via Anthropic, OpenAI and other LLM

 Establish data contracts, schema standards, naming conventions, and a domain model that holds up as we add sources and acquire companies.

 Partner with our Senior Business Analysts embedded in Finance, M&A, and Business Development to translate use cases into platform requirements and to unblock their work.

 Define security, privacy, and AI safety guardrails. Classify data, design access tiering, and set the rules for handling PII, regulated data, and confidential portfolio information.

 Stay hands-on. Write code, ship infrastructure, run code reviews, and debug production issues. Architects who do not build lose touch.

 Build the team including vertical aligned Senior Business AI Analysts. Find suitable contractors for data platform engineers, ML platform engineers, and data engineers. Mentor them. Set the bar for engineering quality.

 Own platform reliability, observability, and cost. Set SLOs, monitor usage, and keep the bill rational as we scale.

 Represent Banyan's AI and data architecture to our executive team, our portfolio companies, and external partners.

 First-Year Outcomes

 A production-ready, governed data lake foundation deployed on AWS, with at least three priority data domains landed and modeled.

 At least two functional verticals onboarded to the platform with safe, audited data access for analytics and AI experimentation.

 A documented reference architecture, security model, and standards library that new use cases and new hires can plug into.

 At least one AI use case running in production through the platform, with monitoring, evaluation, and a clear ROI story.

 First one to two team hires made and ramped.

 Who You Are

 10+ years building data and AI platforms in production at meaningful scale. You have shipped, not just diagrammed.

 Deep AWS expertise. Hands-on with S3, IAM, KMS, networking, Glue, Lake Formation, Athena, Redshift, SageMaker, Bedrock, and EKS or ECS.

 Strong data architecture chops: lakehouse patterns, open table formats (Iceberg, Delta, or Hudi), data modeling, ingestion frameworks (Fivetran, Airbyte, custom), orchestration (Airflow, Dagster, or similar), and lineage.

 Real experience with modern AI/ML platform patterns: feature stores, model registries, experiment tracking, prompt and evaluation frameworks, retrieval-augmented generation, and basic agentic workflows.

 A working point of view on AI safety: data classification, PII handling, access tiering, evaluation, and model-risk controls.

 Hands-on coder. Strong Python and SQL. Comfortable in Terraform or AWS CDK. Reads logs, fixes issues, ships pull requests.

 Player-coach experience. You have led small teams, mentored engineers, set hiring bars, and grown people.

 A strong communicator. You can drive an architecture decision review with engineers and explain trade-offs to executives in the same week.

 Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field. A master's degree is a plus, not a requirement.

 Bonus Points

 Experience in private-equity-backed or holding-company environments with multiple business units and inconsistent source systems.

 Experience designing AI guardrails for non-public, regulated, or competitively sensitive data.

 Track record of treating internal platforms as products, with named users, SLAs, and a real adoption strategy.

 Experience with Snowflake or Databricks. Useful when bridging to portfolio company data without forcing a single stack.

 Past experience as the first or early platform hire at a growth-stage company.

 Why Banyan

 Greenfield with real budget. You set the foundation, you do not inherit a tangle.

 Real ownership of the AI and data architecture for an entire holding company.

 A long-term horizon. We do not optimize for the next quarter, so the platform you build can compound.

 A team that treats AI as a serious capability, not a buzzword. We have already built internal AI tooling we use every day.

 A culture of accountable autonomy. We trust you to do the work.

 Competitive compensation, benefits, and meaningful long-term upside.

 Quick Facts

 Team 

 AI & Data Science

 Reports to 

 Head of AI (And Or) Head of IT

 Scope 

 Player-coach. Hands-on architect today, leading a small platform team over time.

 Location 

 100% Remote

 Type 

 Full-time

 Level 

 Lead

 Compensation 

 Competitive base of CAD $180,000 to $210,000 plus performance bonus and benefits. Final offer reflects experience and qualifications.

 How to Apply

 Send your resume and a short note describing a data or AI platform you have architected. Tell us the choices you made, what shipped to production, and what you would do differently if you were starting over today.

 We look forward to hearing from you.
 Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Equal Employment Opportunity at Banyan: Banyan affirms that inequality is detrimental to our Global Teams, associates, our Operating Companies, and the communities we serve. As a collective, our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions. Together, we unite for equality and equity.  AI at BambooHR 

 At BambooHR, we’re all about setting people free to do great work, and we believe AI is a powerful partner in that mission. We’re leaning into intelligent tools to streamline our workflows, giving us more time for high-impact innovation. We look for curious, forward-thinking people who are ready to explore how AI can elevate their work and help us reimagine the future of HR.

 Essential Job Duties 

 BambooHR is seeking a Distinguished Architect to partner with the VPs of Software Engineering, Software Architects, and Cloud Engineering in leading the Bamboo Product’s Data Technology Architecture. In this role, the Distinguished Architect defines and stewards the architectural vision for our overall Data Technology. This position is accountable for the cohesive architecture of BambooHR’s product data platform, ensuring alignment and interoperability across domains in collaboration with domain architects and engineering leadership . The role includes defining the multi-year data platform architecture, establishing standards and guardrails, and mentoring and influencing architects and principal engineers to deliver a resilient , secure, compliant, and cost-efficient multi-tenant SaaS. 

 You will:

 Set data storage vision & reference architectures for a resilient , secure, compliant, multi‑tenant SaaS: identity & permissions, tenancy, configuration, notifications, audit, and compliance guardrails. 

 Architect and guide the evolution of our data storage technology: continuity of data, relational databases, replication strategy, caching, graphing, and multi-tenancy. Work closely with the platform on how these systems support UDM and API platform data innovation. 

 Architect and influence data technology modernization : evolve BambooHR’s core data architecture—modernizing legacy systems, enabling scalable cloud-native patterns, and ensuring the platform is positioned for future innovation and growth. 

 Collaborate with Product and Engineering leadership to define and communicate the product vision and strategy from a data architecture perspective—representing the architectural vision and tradeoffs to the executive leadership team to ensure alignment across business, product, and technology. 

 Elevate how internal developers build on top of the data platform: evolve the Internal Developer Platform (IDP) to empower teams with standardized, self-service developer workflows, standard approaches, and self-service tooling that accelerate delivery and improve DORA metrics and time-to-first-service. 

 Provide architectural guidance for Data & AI platform patterns : guide data modeling, streaming, analytics, AI/agent platform patterns, and evaluation/observability. 

 Ensure reliability, security & compliance by design : public SLOs and error budgets, progressive delivery (canaries), chaos testing, multi-region DR; authN/authZ (OAuth2/OIDC/SAML; RBAC/ABAC), secure webhooks, audit logging; SOC 2/ISO 27001/GDPR baked into designs and pipelines. 

 Guide growth, monetization & FinOps enablement : usage metering, entitlements, pricing tiers, quotas/rate limits; embed unit-economics telemetry (cost per call/event/tenant) to guide caching, capacity, storage tiers, and retention policies.

 What You Need to Get the Job Done 

 10+ years designing and operating data storage technology at scale in cloud‑native SaaS (AWS/GCP, MySQL, relational, graph database, NoSQL, caching, event systems, progressive delivery). 

 Proven ownership of data movement through developer portals and partner onboarding/marketplaces; shipped versioning/deprecation programs and webhook/event architectures (REST/GraphQL; Kafka/PubSub or equivalents). 

 Deep security & tenancy : OAuth2/OIDC, scope design, RBAC/ABAC, multi‑tenant isolation, auditing, privacy‑preserving patterns, and compliance baked into workflows. 

 Reliability & observability fluency : tracing/logs/metrics, SLO/error‑budget culture, chaos/DR patterns, secure webhook delivery. 

 DevEx & efficiency impact : measurable DORA improvements, faster time‑to‑first‑service, and improved unit economics/FinOps. 

 What Will Make Us REALLY Love You 

 You’ve transformed developer experience—measurably improving DORA metrics and internal satisfaction through intuitive platforms and golden paths. 

 You’ve inspired architectural clarity and alignment across teams, helping leadership and engineers alike rally around a cohesive technical vision. 

 You’ve cultivated thriving developer ecosystems —both internally and externally—through SDKs, integrations, and marketplaces.

 You’re a multiplier of talent : a coach, mentor, and community-builder who elevates architecture culture across the organization. 

 You’re known for driving change through influence —able to balance pragmatism with innovation and communicate complex ideas simply.

 401k plans with up to 6% company match

 $2000 Paid-Paid Vacation bonus

 Check out all our benefits that benefit you

jobs.title: Data Architect  (Managed Services)
jobs.description:
ROLE OVERVIEW 

 We are looking for a seasoned Data Architect with deep expertise in enterprise data warehousing, ETL/ELT pipeline development, and business intelligence. You will be responsible for the end-to-end design and implementation of our data architecture — from data ingestion and cleansing to dimensional modeling, warehouse construction, and BI dashboard delivery. You will also establish robust data governance frameworks including data catalogs, lineage tracking, and security audit systems. This role requires strong hands-on capability combined with architectural vision, and prior experience in complex industries such as finance, international trade, or manufacturing is highly valued.

 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

 Data Acquisition, Cleansing & Integration 

 Design and implement enterprise-wide data collection strategies across heterogeneous source systems (ETRM, ERP, CRM, external APIs, flat files, and databases).

 Develop robust data cleansing and standardization pipelines to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and completeness across all data sources.

 Build data integration frameworks to consolidate data from disparate systems into a unified enterprise data warehouse, handling schema evolution and data drift.

 Implement Change Data Capture (CDC) mechanisms and incremental data loading strategies to ensure near real-time data freshness.

 Data Warehouse Architecture & Modeling 

 Lead the design and construction of the enterprise data warehouse (EDW) using industry-proven methodologies (Inmon, Kimball, or Data Vault).

 Apply dimensional modeling expertise to design star schemas, snowflake schemas, and constellation models optimized for analytical query performance.

 architect data marts for specific business domains (finance, sales, supply chain, operations) with clear separation of concerns.

 Select and implement appropriate data warehouse technologies based on workload characteristics: batch analytics (Hive, Spark SQL), real-time analytics (ClickHouse, Apache Doris, StarRocks), or MPP databases (Greenplum, Vertica).

 Design layered data architectures (ODS → DWD → DWS → ADS / Bronze → Silver → Gold) with clear data flow and transformation logic at each layer.

 ETL/ELT Pipeline Development 

 Design, build, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Apache Spark, Flink, Hive, MapReduce, or proprietary ETL tools (Informatica, Talend, Kettle).

 Implement workflow orchestration using Apache Airflow, DolphinScheduler, Azkaban, or Oozie to schedule, monitor, and manage data pipelines.

 Establish data quality frameworks: automated validation rules, anomaly detection, data profiling, and quality scorecards to ensure pipeline reliability and data trustworthiness.

 Build comprehensive monitoring and alerting systems for pipeline health, data freshness, and SLA compliance.

 Optimize pipeline performance through partitioning, bucketing, indexing, and query tuning strategies.

 Business Intelligence & Reporting 

 Develop enterprise BI reporting systems and interactive dashboards using tools such as Apache Superset, FineBI, Tableau, Power BI, or Quick BI.

 Design executive dashboards, operational reports, and self-service analytics interfaces tailored to business stakeholders across finance, trading, operations, and management.

 Implement metrics frameworks (KPIs, OKRs) and ensure data definitions are standardized, documented, and consistently applied across all reports.

 Work directly with business units to understand analytical requirements and translate them into effective data models and visualizations.

 Data Governance & Standards 

 Design and implement enterprise data governance frameworks from the ground up, including data ownership policies, stewardship roles, and governance workflows.

 Build a centralized data catalog (using Apache Atlas, DataHub, Amundsen, or similar) documenting all data assets, business glossaries, and metadata.

 Implement data lineage analysis systems to track data flow from source to consumption, enabling impact analysis and root cause diagnosis.

 Establish data security and audit frameworks: access control (RBAC/ABAC), data masking, encryption policies, sensitive data discovery, and compliance audit trails.

 Define and enforce data standards: naming conventions, data dictionaries, master data management (MDM) rules, and data quality SLAs.

 Ensure regulatory compliance with data protection laws (GDPR, PIPL, industry-specific regulations) through governance controls and documentation.

 REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS 

 Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Information Systems, or related technical field.

 3+ years of professional experience in data development, data engineering, or data architecture roles, with a proven track record of building production data warehouse systems.

 Expert-level proficiency in SQL (complex queries, window functions, CTEs, query optimization) and Python for data processing and pipeline development.

 Mastery of data warehouse modeling theories and methodologies: dimensional modeling (Kimball), normalized modeling (Inmon), and Data Vault 2.0. Demonstrated experience designing star schemas, snowflake schemas, and aggregate tables for complex business domains.

 Deep domain experience in at least one complex industry: financial services (banking, securities, insurance), international trade (import/export, supply chain, logistics), or manufacturing (production planning, quality control, industrial IoT). Understanding of industry-specific data entities, business processes, and analytical requirements.

 Strong hands-on experience with ETL/ELT tools and frameworks: Apache Spark (batch and streaming), Apache Flink, Hive, MapReduce, Sqoop, DataX, SeaTunnel, or commercial ETL platforms (Informatica PowerCenter, Talend, IBM DataStage).

 Proficiency in workflow orchestration: Apache Airflow, DolphinScheduler, Azkaban, Oozie, or equivalent scheduling and monitoring platforms.

 Production experience with at least one major data warehouse/analytics database: ClickHouse, Apache Doris, StarRocks, Hive, Greenplum, Vertica, Teradata, or Snowflake.

 Strong hands-on experience with BI and visualization tools: Apache Superset, FineBI, Tableau, Power BI, Quick BI, or similar enterprise BI platforms.

 Deep expertise in Data Governance with demonstrated ability to build governance systems from scratch: data catalog implementation, metadata management, automated lineage tracking (using OpenLineage, Marquez, or similar), data quality monitoring, and security audit frameworks.

 Solid understanding of relational and analytical databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, SQL Server, Greenplum — including performance tuning, indexing strategies, and query optimization.

 Experience with big data ecosystem components: HDFS, YARN, ZooKeeper, Kafka, and Hadoop distributions (CDH, HDP, Apache).

 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 

 Experience with master data management (MDM) platforms and methodologies.

 Familiarity with data mesh or data fabric architectural patterns for large-scale decentralized data environments.

 Experience with data versioning and time-travel capabilities in modern data warehouses.

 Domain knowledge on Energy Trading, Market Risk Management.

 Professional certifications: CDMP (Certified Data Management Professional), DAMA-DMBOK, or vendor-specific data platform certifications.

 Any personal data you share with us during the application process will be processed strictly in compliance with applicable data protection laws and our Privacy Notice .

About the Role

 Betterment’s Analytics Engineering team turns complex company data into reliable, well-modeled data products that support analytics, finance, marketing and other business needs across Betterment. The team works across the data lifecycle—from transforming and testing warehouse data to operating pipelines and enabling trusted data to flow into downstream systems.

 As Senior Manager, you will set the direction for this work and lead the people and operating model that make it reliable at company scale. You will grow a high-performing team of analytics engineers, shape a roadmap that balances shared foundations with business needs, and ensure our data products are accurate, understandable, observable, and useful. You will partner closely with Analytics, Data Platform, Product Engineering, Finance, Marketing, CRM, and Revenue Operations to turn business problems into scalable data capabilities.

 This role combines strategic leadership with technical judgment. You will stay close enough to the architecture and work to guide important decisions, while empowering your team to own implementation and outcomes. You will help Betterment build trusted data foundations for both decision-making and operational workflows.

This role is based out of our NYC office. Below we've reflected the base salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary depending on factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of Betterment’s total compensation package for employees. 

 New York City: $180,000-$210,000

 This job may also be eligible for variable compensation in the form of a company incentive bonus. 

 A Day in the Life

 Set and communicate the Analytics Engineering vision, roadmap, and priorities, connecting data investments to business outcomes.

 Lead, coach, and grow individual contributors; set clear expectations, support career development, and build a healthy, inclusive team culture.

jobs.title: Graduate Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Fospha is the measurement system enterprise retail and ecommerce brands run their business on. We give marketing teams one clear, daily view of what's actually working — across every channel and everywhere they sell, from their website to Amazon and TikTok Shop — down to the level of a single ad or piece of creative. It replaces guesswork and gut feel with a number marketing, finance and agencies can all trust and act on.

 Brands including Dyson, Gymshark, Adanola and Huel use Fospha up to 25 times a day to decide where budget should move next. We've spent over a decade building this, with more than $40 billion in marketing spend now optimised through the platform — and we're scaling fast across London, Mumbai and Austin.

 About the role

 Fospha's measurement products run on data pipelines that process marketing spend and performance data for brands you'll recognise. You'll get exposure across our core data engineering workstreams: large-scale SQL/dbt transformation pipelines, data ingestion services, and pipelines that turn aggregated data into insights served through APIs. You'll work alongside data engineers, analysts, and AI agents as part of our AI-first operating model, with senior engineers supporting you as you build real ownership.

 This role suits a recent graduate (or someone with a strong personal/academic project record) who's curious about data pipelines and wants to learn by shipping real, production code from day one.

 What you'll do

 Write and maintain dbt models and SQL as part of our production data engineering pipelines, learning the transformation patterns we build on

 Help build and maintain Python-based data ingestion services, with guidance from senior engineers

 Contribute to pipelines that move data from ingestion through transformation to the APIs that serve it

 Write clean, tested code and get comfortable with code review from both sides — giving and receiving feedback

 Debug data quality issues systematically, learning to trace problems back through the pipeline

 Get exposure to our cloud infrastructure and understand how it supports the pipelines you work on

 Work with AI agents as part of our AI-first operating model, learning to write clear specifications that shape high-quality, AI-assisted engineering work

 Collaborate with data engineers, analysts, and product stakeholders to understand what the data needs to support

 The Centre of Excellence

 The Centre of Excellence is Fospha's early-careers programme that develops ambitious, high-performing talent through focused training, hands-on experience and cross-functional exposure. Starting in Data Engineering, you'll gain foundational experience while being prepared for future opportunities across the organisation. The programme operates on the following principles:

 Individual Responsibility from the Get-go: You will quickly be responsible for the success of your work, able to make an individual impact early in your career

 Work alongside SLT at Leading Businesses: You will be engaging with Senior Leadership and C-Level executives at the leading retail brands, getting exposure to how the top companies operate

 Cross-Functional Exposure: we offer unique opportunities to learn from and collaborate with every department in the business — many daily

 Comprehensive Training: In addition to the extensive on-the-job learning opportunities, you'll receive a broad and blended in-person training curriculum covering essential topics such as Business Storytelling, Account Management, Market Research & Product and Financial Management

 Real Mentorship: Regular one-to-ones, feedback, and career conversations with people invested in your progression, not just your output

 Career Development: High performers have clear opportunities to quickly advance their careers at Fospha — whether progressing within Data Engineering toward senior technical and/or leadership roles or moving into other departments that align with their skills and interests

 Modern Tools: Hands-on exposure to Gen AI tooling and AI-assisted coding (we use Claude Code day-to-day), so you're building modern, AI-fluent ways of working rather than legacy processes

 What we're looking for

 Essential

 A relevant degree (Computer Science, Data Engineering, Mathematics, or similar), or equivalent experience through internships/placements/personal projects

 Some experience with SQL and Python

 Genuine curiosity about how data pipelines work end-to-end, not just the code but why the data looks the way it does

 Comfortable being reviewed and iterating quickly on feedback

 Confident asking questions and pushing for clarity rather than staying blocked

 Nice to have

 Exposure to dbt or another SQL transformation framework

 Familiarity with Git/GitHub and PR-based workflows

 Some exposure to AWS or another cloud environment

 Experience writing or maintaining automated tests

 Interest in AI-assisted coding tools (we use Claude Code day-to-day)

 Any exposure to marketing, ecommerce, or advertising data

 What we can offer you

 Salary: Competitive + bonus

 A £1,000/year flexible benefits allowance to put towards private medical insurance, dental cover, a health cash plan, gym membership, extra holiday, or a pension top-up — whatever suits you

 Access to Wellhub, giving you one membership across gyms, boutique studios, and wellbeing apps

 25 days' annual leave plus 8 UK bank holidays, an extra day off for your birthday, and more holiday the longer you stay (26 days after 3 years, 27 after 6)

 Regular socials, free weekly snacks, and Lunch & Learn events at our Scale Space office, plus access to the wider Blenheim Chalcot community

 Opportunities to travel — including to our India and North America offices

 Life assurance worth 4x your annual salary

 Why Fospha

 Real production impact from day one. The pipelines you help build feed measurement products used to make real budget decisions.

 A published career framework. No guessing what the next level requires or when you'll get there.

 A team that reviews each other's work properly. Code review from people who care about getting the data right.

 An AI-first operating model where lean, high-autonomy teams ship fast and learn faster — with structured mentorship from senior engineers as you build that fluency yourself.

 Our Values and Principles

 You will be able to demonstrate examples of our core principles:

 Seek inclusion & diversity: We create an environment where everyone feels welcome, and people are encouraged to speak and be heard

 Work Hard, Work Well, Work Together: We take responsibility for making things happen, independently and together; we help colleagues in need and close loops, making sure our work is complete and has lasting impact

 Grow: We are proactive, curious and unafraid of failure

 Customer at the heart: We care about the customer, feel their pain and love building product that solves their biggest problems

 Candour with caring: We deliver candid feedback with kindness and receive it with gratitude

 By submitting your CV you understand that we have a legitimate interest to use your personal data for the purposes of assessing your eligibility for this role. This means that we may use your personal data to contact you to discuss your CV or arrange an interview, or transfer your CV to the hiring manager(s) of the role you have applied for. You can ask us at any time to remove your CV from our database by emailing recruitment@blenheimchalcot.com – but please note that this means we will no longer consider you for the role you have applied for. You can review our privacy policy here .

Sobre a Blip 

 A Blip é a maior empresa de inteligência conversacional e mensageria do Brasil, com hubs de inovação e operação no Brasil, México e Espanha, impulsionando a operação de mais de 4.000 clientes em escala global . Com foco em soluções escaláveis, nós integramos dados, IA e contexto de ponta a ponta para orquestrar jornadas conversacionais completas, substituindo interações isoladas por decisões estratégicas, com a missão de garantir que cada contato vire aprendizado contínuo e eficiência para o negócio, entregando a infraestrutura definitiva para criar conversas que geram resultado . 

 Sobre o time 

 A pessoa Analytics Engineer Sênior integra o time da esteira de dados de Professional Services que atende todos os clientes da Blip , atuando em um ambiente estruturado e altamente colaborativo ao lado de cientistas, analistas e engenheiros de dados , onde assume o papel estratégico de transformar volumes de dados brutos em bases confiáveis, modeladas e acionáveis , garantindo a sustentabilidade dos pipelines e apoiando as tomadas de decisão de negócio com uso contínuo de inteligência artificial e estatística aplicada no dia a dia . 

 Responsabilidades 

 Construir e orquestrar pipelines de dados escaláveis para garantir o fluxo contínuo e confiável de informações . 

 Desenvolver rotinas em PySpark para processar grandes volumes de dados com eficiência . 

 Modelar bases de dados aplicando regras de negócio para consolidar fontes únicas de verdade . 

 Criar e evoluir dashboards e modelos semânticos em Power BI integrados às necessidades do negócio . 

 Implementar testes de qualidade e governança para garantir a integridade das bases de dados . 

 Versionar códigos, scripts e dashboards em repositórios seguindo boas práticas colaborativas . 

 Aplicar estatística básica para validação de resultados e preparação estruturada de bases . 

 Articular com equipes analíticas para traduzir necessidades técnicas em soluções acionáveis . 

 Qualificações 

 Experiência prática consistente com desenvolvimento em PySpark . 

 Domínio em criação e manutenção de visões analíticas no Power BI . 

 Experiência com construção, gerenciamento e orquestração de pipelines de dados . 

 Vivência em controle de versão de código e ativos analíticos em ambiente de repositório . 

 Experiência de trabalho atuando de forma colaborativa em equipes multidisciplinares . 

 Conhecimento de estatística básica voltada à preparação de amostragem e validações . 

 Uso prático de ferramentas de IA para ganho de produtividade e otimização de rotinas . 

 Capacidade de traduzir conceitos técnicos para interlocutores de diferentes áreas . 

 Leitura e escrita técnica em inglês .

Our connected beverage platform eliminates the need for single-use bottles and cans, making it easy, fun, and sustainable to stay hydrated. As the category leader in IoT-enabled beverage technology, we're building a future where Bevi machines are everywhere people live, work, and connect. We've raised over $160M in venture capital, serve thousands of customers across the US, Canada, UK and Ireland, and we've been rapidly growing year over year, saving over 1 billion bottles from waste. In addition to driving hypergrowth with our current product line, Bevi is heavily investing in new product development.

 We're looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to own the foundation the entire Data & Data Science org builds on. This is a senior individual-contributor role — reporting directly to our Head of Data — that's both strategic and deeply hands-on, spanning the full data platform stack from Git-based build standards through ingestion, transformation, and self-service BI. You'll work alongside other senior technical leaders on the team, each owning deep technical domains of their own. It's a real, complex system, and it's how you show you can build on the platform you're setting standards for, not just describe best practices. You'll design and build the architecture and governance that let a growing team of analytics engineers, data scientists, and AI tools build and ship safely and independently, at speed, without sacrificing accuracy. This isn't a role that writes a playbook and hands it off: you'll build the platform yourself, evolve what the team has already put in place, and be the person other engineers look to for how it's done right. The right candidate combines deep technical expertise with innovation and operational excellence, thriving in a hands-on role to deliver scalable, production-ready, high-impact data solutions.

 Your Day to Day: 

 Own the full data platform — ingestion, modeling, self-service, CI/CD, and visualization — including the process, documentation, and enforcement that keeps standards followed.

 Design and build best-in-class reliable, scalable, and performant data architecture and data flows to support the democratization of data, analytics, AI, and ML initiatives.

 Partner with Software to identify, recommend, and implement the right tech stack to support streaming data at scale that integrates into our existing stack: Fivetran, Snowflake, dbt, Looker, Grafana.

 Own data modeling, transformation, and orchestration for IOT — machine sensors, digital UI interactions, and beverage consumption — partnering with Software, Hardware, Product, and Operations to translate complex data needs into production-ready solutions.

 Build the governed self-service model that lets teams build and ship their own data work safely; includes permissioning, PR-based peer review, production-readiness standards, and full lineage/traceability from source to dashboard.

 Continue to evolve how AI connects to our data including the governance and guardrails that let AI operate at scale without sacrificing accuracy.

 Continue to evolve the monitoring and alerting process so that it is scalable and reliable; comprehensive with minimal noise.

 Define and enforce best practices for privacy, governance, and security — including how we handle sensitive data (e.g., HR/people data) — and build the audit-ready rigor and change-management discipline a fast-scaling company needs.

 Collaborate with Data Science team members to enable advanced analytics, experimentation, and AI/ML modeling.

 Provide technical leadership to engineers across the Data & Data Science organization.

 Stay current with emerging data technologies and recommend strategic improvements to the data platform.

 Who You Are: 

 8+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or platform engineering, with demonstrated ownership of a full production data platform (not just a slice of it).

 Expert with modern cloud data stack tooling: Fivetran, Snowflake, dbt, and a modern BI layer (Looker or similar).

 Fluent in how AI tools consume data — designed or governed access patterns for LLMs/AI agents querying structured data (eg semantic layers, read-only access controls, tool-calling patterns).

 Deep, hands-on experience architecting streaming and batch data pipelines at scale (e.g., Kafka, Kinesis, Spark, InfluxDB).

 Track record designing governance models that let non-engineers quickly and safely self-serve — permissions, PR/review workflows, production-readiness gates.

 Experience building the observability layer for a data platform — monitoring, alerting, lineage, and data quality tracking — so breaks get caught immediately and every dataset can be traced from source to consumption.

 Strong SQL and Python, with a demonstrated track record of independently driving ambiguous, cross-functional problems all the way to production — not just recommending a solution, but building and shipping it yourself.

 Track record of mentoring engineers and driving innovation within high-performing data teams.

jobs.title: Intern, Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Who we are 

 We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

 Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

 Your Mission 

 As a Data Engineering Intern in our Data Hub team in Barcelona, you will build and operate a modern data platform that empowers teams across Bitpanda. Working alongside experienced data engineers, you will gain hands-on experience turning raw data into reliable, high-quality data products. This role provides direct mentorship, best-in-class engineering standards, and an environment where your growth is actively supported.

 Hiring for these positions kicks off in October 2026 for a 6-month, full-time role, starting on February 1, 2027. 

 What you'll do 

 Build reliable data pipelines: Write clean Python and SQL code to design, implement, and maintain ETL pipelines for data ingestion and transformation.

 Create impactful data products: Develop clean datasets and data models that empower analysts, business stakeholders, and decision-makers across Bitpanda.

 Master engineering standards: Apply solid engineering practices, including version control, automated testing, code reviews, and CI/CD workflows.

 Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner with teams across Product, Operations, and Finance to translate business requirements into pragmatic data solutions.

 Manage projects: Take ownership of data engineering workflows and project deliverables under the guidance of experienced team members.

 Who you are 

 Data enthusiast: You have a foundational background in Computer Science or completed a relevant coding bootcamp with a strong focus on data engineering.

 Python & SQL skilled: You have practical experience writing Python scripts and SQL queries through personal projects, coursework, or practical training.

 Cloud & data aware: You grasp core data engineering concepts and have basic exposure to cloud environments (preferably AWS, or GCP/Azure).

 Curious & growth-minded: You are highly motivated, comfortable asking questions, eager to receive feedback, and excited to solve tough engineering problems.

 Collaborative team player: You are fluent in English with strong communication skills and eager to work alongside analysts and engineers to build useful data tools.

 What’s in it for you 

 Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.

 Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.

 Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.

 Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.

 Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.

 Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.

 Support during life milestones – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family.

 Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.

 Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.

 Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.

 Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

 .…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

 Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

 Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. 

 * These benefits may be adjusted at Bitpanda’s discretion and do not apply to our internships and exceptions to our Hybrid Working policy apply to teams with shift schedules or for folks whose roles require them to be in-office (think: Workplaces team or IT).

jobs.title: Staff Database Engineer
jobs.description:
Innovate with purpose 

 At BILL, we believe in empowering the businesses that drive our economy. By replacing outdated financial processes with innovative tools, we help businesses—from startups to established brands—make smarter decisions and gain control of their operations. And we don’t stop there: we’re creating the future of financial automation so businesses can spend more time on what matters.

 Working here means you become part of a vision-driven team that’s ready to tackle challenges and build cutting-edge solutions. We value purpose, drive, and curiosity—and we thrive in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment. We're remote-first, with office spaces in San Jose, CA and Draper, UT — and opportunities to connect in person when it counts. BILLders collaborate to deliver real impact for businesses that need more time in their busy weeks.

 BILL builds high performing teams and we seek to hire the best talent for every role. We're committed to building a workplace that fosters inclusion and diverse perspectives, valuing each person’s unique skills and experiences. We’d love to hear from you—you might be just what we’re looking for, whether in this role or another.

 ✨ Let’s give businesses more time for what matters.

 Make your impact within a rapidly growing Fintech Company 

 The Core Infrastructure Team is responsible for managing all of the infrastructure and databases at BILL. We utilize Foglight, DataDog (for Logging, Metrics, and APM), Splunk, and CloudWatch (through Datadog integration) for real-time alerts via Slack and PagerDuty. We are strong advocates of Infrastructure as Code, and to achieve this, we utilize Terraform and AWS ECS.

 We are looking for a Staff Database Engineer with strong developer experience in PostgreSQL, Oracle, and DynamoDB to join us in building, scaling, and automating our mission-critical database platforms. In this role, you will design automated database infrastructure, write custom tooling, and build resilient real-time data replication architecture by streaming data from databases into Kafka using tools like Oracle GoldenGate and Debezium to power the BILL suite of applications. As a member of our team, you will collaborate closely with Systems Engineers, Developers, and Architects to engineer high-performance, event-driven data pipelines and self-service database systems. 

 As a Staff Database Engineer, you will serve as both a system architect and builder. Joining a team of dedicated engineers, you will contribute to the design, automation, and optimization of our PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL, and DynamoDB environments, building modern CI/CD pipelines, automated failovers, and scalable Kafka-based CDC frameworks to ensure stability and real-time data availability. 

 We’d love to chat if you have: 

 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

 8+ years in database administration (PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL) with strong skills in optimization, security, and access control, including 3+ years managing databases on AWS

 Proficient in Python or Go

 Expert in IaC with Terraform and Git, applying an SDLC approach to infrastructure

 Advanced experience with replication tools like GoldenGate or Debezium

 Solid SQL skills and experience in complex query optimization

 Experience with monitoring and alerting tools like DataDog, Splunk, and CloudWatch for real-time performance monitoring and issue resolution

 Desired Qualifications: 

 Experience with NoSQL databases such as DynamoDB and MongoDB

 AWS certified Database - Specialty and Terraform certification

 Our ranges for each role and job level are based on a variety of factors including candidate experience, expertise, and geographic location and may vary from the amounts listed below. The role is also eligible for a competitive benefits package that includes: medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, flexible spending & health savings account, paid holidays, paid time off, and other company benefits.
