jobs.title: Tech Lead Data Engineer
jobs.description:
What Makes Cloudbeds Unique 

 At Cloudbeds , we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've continually been recognized for excellence, most recently earning top honors at the 2026 HotelTechAwards for Best Hotel Management Software and landing on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again, but we're just getting started.

 Our Data Analytics & BI Team: 

 We are a small, senior, fully remote team running analytics for the entire company on Snowflake, dbt, Matillion, and Sigma. We move fast and ship things people use daily. What we're missing is a senior technical voice to make the foundational calls — architecture, platform, governance, ML Ops — so that speed compounds instead of accumulating debt. That's this role, and it comes with unusual latitude to decide how the platform should work.

 How You'll Make an Impact: 

 As our Tech Lead Data Engineer & Data Architect, you will shape the technical direction, architectural standards, and data governance of our core Data Analytics platform. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will act as our Data Architect—owning logical and physical data modeling, warehouse design, and layered curation (staging → intermediate → mart)—while serving as our Data Engineering Tech Lead.

 You will help continuously modernize our tech stack, elevating our software engineering discipline across our data pipelines (DataOps/CI-CD), optimizing compute performance and costs, driving MLOps workflows, and reinforcing data quality and security standards. Crucially, you will drive our AI-readiness initiatives—architecting the semantic layers, data structures, and access patterns needed to make our data seamless and reliable for AI agents and automated workflows. You will serve as the technical anchor for a talented team of Analytical Engineers, collaborating closely with Engineering, Infrastructure, Data Science / ML, and business stakeholders to ensure our data ecosystem is reliable, scalable, and business-ready.

 What You Bring to the Team: 

 Data Architecture & Modeling Ownership: Set and evolve our cloud data architecture on Snowflake. Own data model design across data products and marts, implementing flexible dimensional models (Star Schemas, SCDs, conformed dimensions) and documenting decisions through Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).

 Data Engineering Competency: Lead the end-to-end design and execution of data pipelines—owning ingestion, API integrations, custom connectors, ELT/ETL processes, and pipeline orchestration.

 DataOps & CI/CD Integration: Build upon our existing Git, CI/CD, and Jira workflows by embedding specialized data discipline—such as automated dbt testing on pull requests, environment isolation, automated credential management, and data deployment standards.

 Governance & Observability Strategy: Build upon and refine the initial foundations of our governance model. Evaluate, select, and implement scalable Data Catalog and Data Observability solutions to track data lineage, ensure freshness, monitor completeness, and automate failure alerting.

 Platform Efficiency & Cost Control: Continuously tune Snowflake query performance, clustering, and warehouse sizing to optimize execution times and compute spend.

 Technical Mentorship & Agile Leadership: Raise the technical effectiveness of Analytical Engineers within our Agile planning framework through architectural guidance, design reviews, and constructive challenge.

 Stack Modernization & Architecture Evolution: Continuously evaluate new tools, frameworks, and architecture patterns to modernize, optimize, and add flexibility to our data stack.

 What Sets You Up for Success: 

 Senior Hands-On Experience: Proven track record as a Senior Data Engineer, Data Architect, or Tech Lead in cloud data environments.

 AI & Agent Readiness: Exposure to preparing data structures, semantic models, feature stores, and API/access layers for AI agents, machine learning pipelines, and automated LLM workflows.

 Snowflake & dbt Mastery: Deep hands-on expertise administering, tuning, and modeling in Snowflake, alongside advanced mastery of dbt (macros, incremental models, custom tests, packages, and dbt-native CI/CD testing).

 Advanced SQL & Python Skills: Expert analytical SQL skills (query execution plan tuning, window functions, CTEs) and strong Python proficiency for data pipelines, scripting, and MLOps workflows.

 Orchestration & Tool Evaluation: Practical experience with ingestion and orchestration engines (e.g., Matillion, Apache Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, Fivetran), with a strong ability to evaluate architectural trade-offs, performance, and costs when selecting or migrating platforms.

 DataOps & Software Engineering Discipline: Experience operating with active Git and CI/CD pipelines, with a track record of extending these systems to include automated data testing, deployment validation, and secure credential rotation.

 Critical Thinking & Problem Decomposition: Tendency to question assumptions, gather full business context, form hypotheses, and rigorously evaluate outputs (especially for AI/ML outputs) before jumping to technical solutions.

 Pragmatic Experimentation: Passion for building lightweight MVPs and Proofs of Concept (POCs) to evaluate new technologies, test architectural hypotheses, and modernize the data stack.

 Communication & Technical Influence: Business-level English fluency with the ability to articulate complex technical trade-offs clearly, mentor teammates, and collaborate effectively in a remote, globally distributed team.

 Bonus Skills to Stand Out: 

 Exposure to applied AI tooling (Snowflake Cortex, AI Classify, RAG workflows, LLM agents, MCP servers).

 Familiarity with modern BI consumption tools like Sigma or workflow engines like n8n.

 Work Authorization: Please note that applicants must be currently authorized to work in the location where the position is located without requiring visa sponsorship. At this time, Cloudbeds is unable to provide sponsorship for work visas.

 What to Expect - Your Journey with Us 

 Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ team members across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, hoteliers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle. Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in tech who are obsessed with using AI to transform a trillion-dollar industry, this is your chance to be part of something extraordinary.

 Everyone is Welcome - A Culture of Inclusion

jobs.title: Lead Data Engineer
jobs.description:
What is Coast 

 Coast is re-imagining the trillion-dollar U.S. B2B card payments infrastructure, with a focus on the country’s 500,000 commercial fleets, 40 million commercial vehicles, and many millions of commercial drivers. The incumbent technologies that cater to these customers are decades old, and businesses with fleets increasingly demand modern digital experiences and transparent financial services products. Coast’s mission is to deliver this at a transformational scale, beginning with the Coast Fleet and Fuel Card built on a cutting-edge spend management platform.

 About the Role 

 We’re looking for a Lead Data Engineer who can not just get their hands dirty building pipelines and also act as a thought leader for the company. Data sits at the center of everything we do, and we need someone who not only understands how to make it available, but how to make it accessible to everyone in the company. In the age of AI, making good decisions is key, and having accurate data is a core part of our decision-making process.

 You won't be starting from scratch. We already run on Redshift, Dagster, and dbt, but the biggest pieces are still yours to build: a data catalog, a semantic layer, a mature security posture, and AI-ready access to our data.

 This is a chance to lead a small, high-leverage team and touch all corners of the company, not just reporting and analytics. Our data organization follows a federated model: product teams own their data products, and the data platform gives them the patterns, tools, and guardrails to do that well. Your job isn't to be the team everyone files tickets with; it's to make everyone else at Coast better at producing and using data.

 What You’ll Do 

 Own Our Data Warehouse 

 Set standards and build patterns for ingesting data

 Make sure data consumers can build models efficiently and quickly

 Build new capabilities, like data catalogs and semantic layers that make data discoverable for your coworkers across the company

 Set data security standards, including tokenization, RBAC, and row-level security

 Provide High-Quality Patterns 

 You should have opinions, we want you to be the expert on the best way to produce and consume data

 Figure out how to make data usable, whether via reverse ETL or making it available to AI agents

 Be a Teacher 

 Help our product engineering teams evolve from treating data as exhaust to building DDD-based data products

 Teach nontechnical users how to consume data using AI tools without needing to learn SQL

 Evangelize new practices and patterns that present opportunities for Coast to remain innovative and nimble

 Write Code 

 Contribute to our data pipelines in Python

 Build CI/CD pipelines for data products

 Contribute new data tests for dbt

 What Success Looks Like 

 In your first year, you’ll be successful if you:

 Provide a model for understanding our data warehouse costs

 Ship a data catalog that helps all employees know where to find good data

 Have a strategy and have made real progress on building a data security posture, including row-level security, RBAC, and tokenization

 Have a strategy and have made real progress on making our data safely accessible to AI agents

 Requirements 

 7+ years hands-on experience working across the data ecosystem, from modern ETL/ELT and orchestration to data warehouses and columnar stores, from BI tooling for less-technical business users to SQL optimization

 AI-native mindset: you’re already using AI tools in your daily work and you’re excited to push further

 Experience with data warehouses such as Redshift or Snowflake (we use Redshift), data pipeline tools (we use Dagster), dbt, and medallion architecture

 Proficiency in Python

 Experience leading a horizontal Data Engineering team, working with analytics and product engineering teams

 Mentorship experience, both of data engineers and members of other teams who have to touch data products

 Excellent written and verbal communication

 Bias toward action and process-building; you don’t wait for someone to hand you a playbook

 Comfortable in ambiguity; you can build structure where none exists without losing momentum

 New York City based; able to be in-office 3–4 days per week

 Compensation and Benefits 

 Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of our total compensation package that also includes benefits and equity. Pay decisions are based on a number of factors, including scope and qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to other Coast employees. We expect the majority of candidates who are offered roles at Coast to fall healthily within the range based on these factors.

 Salary range : $170,000 – $220,000 annually

 Equity Grant : Meaningful potential upside given Coast’s early-stage trajectory

 Benefits Overview :

 Medical, dental and vision insurance

 Flexible paid time off (vacation, personal well being, paid holidays)

 Tools to help manage your financial wellness, including webinars, access to an equity tax advisory service, and company-sponsored 401(k)

 Paid parental leave

 $400 accessories allowance (a keyboard, mouse, headphones, etc.)

 Education stipend

 Free lunch every Friday

 Coast is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We are building a diverse and inclusive environment, so we encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We’re an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, disability, national origin, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

 Check out the latest podcast interview on Fintech Layer Cake with Coast Founder Daniel Simon !

About Clear Street: 

 Clear Street’s mission is to give every sophisticated investor access to every asset, in every market, through a unified platform built for speed, transparency and scale.

We give our clients the technology, tools, and service once reserved for the largest institutions, rebuilt with modern infrastructure. Our single, cloud-native, end-to-end capital markets platform powers investor growth today and is transforming how they can interact with markets tomorrow.

 For more information, visit https://clearstreet.io .

 The Team: 

 The Control Engineering team at Clear Street is a small team with a great deal of responsibility. We work closely with stakeholders to ensure that we meet all our financial and regulatory obligations in a timely fashion. Our goal is to make the lives of our stakeholders easier by leveraging innovative technology to create automated solutions for their workflows. As Clear Street grows into more product lines and geographical regions, every member of the team will have an opportunity to have an immense impact on the firm as a whole. Join our team and be part of a dynamic environment where you can make a significant contribution, collaborate with talented professionals, and work with cutting-edge technology to drive operational excellence.

 The Role:

This range represents Base Salary only, which is just one element of Clear Street's total compensation.  At Clear Street, we offer competitive compensation packages, company equity, 401k matching, gender neutral parental leave, and full medical, dental and vision insurance. jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description 

 Clear Street is modernizing the brokerage ecosystem. Founded in 2018, Clear Street is a diversified financial services firm replacing the legacy infrastructure used across capital markets.

 We started from scratch by building a completely cloud-native clearing and custody system designed for today's complex, global market. Our platform is fully integrated with central clearing houses and exchanges to support billions in trading volume per day. We've agonized about our data model abstractions, created horizontal scalability, and crafted thoughtful APIs. All so we can provide a best-in-class experience for our clients.

 By combining highly-skilled product and engineering talent with seasoned finance professionals, we're building the essentials to compete in today's fast-paced markets.

 The Team: 

 The mission of the Clear Street Active team is to provide best execution for every asset class in every market. Active is building a new, state-of-the-art, cloud-based trading platform giving high-performance traders access to liquidity venues across multiple asset classes, cutting-edge charting, and sophisticated order handling.

 The Active Data team owns how the business understands itself, and increasingly how it decides what to do next. Data flows into our warehouse from ad platforms, product analytics, CRM and support systems, and the brokerage's own systems. It flows back out to the platforms that message our customers, bid for new ones, and manage relationships with them. Every hop is a place where data can be duplicated, delayed, or quietly redefined, and an error that leaves the warehouse does not stay a reporting problem. It spends ad budget on the wrong people, sends a customer the wrong message, or misstates a regulated number. Moving data is table stakes. Keeping it true as it travels is the problem this role owns. It is a small team with a wide surface area, and we are scaling it as the platform grows toward tens of thousands of accounts.

 The Role: 

 Three areas of the business depend on this role, and you will own the data for all of them:

 Growth. Bring in spend, clicks, and conversions from every paid, affiliate, and organic channel, reconcile them against our own records, and send funded-account outcomes back to the ad platforms, so bidding optimizes for customers who actually fund and trade.

 Lifecycle and the user journey. Resolve each customer's identity from a first anonymous visit through sign-up, KYC, funding, and first trade, and keep lifecycle messaging, CRM, and support systems in step with what actually happened.

 Brokerage data. Model account opening, KYC, funding and transfers, and trading from the platform's own systems, with the precision a regulated broker-dealer needs.

 Across all three, you will:

 Own data integrity in both directions. Prove that every feed arrived complete and on time, and that every outbound sync landed what it should. A duplicated conversion inflates ad spend, a stale attribute sends the wrong message, and a broken join misstates funded accounts to leadership.

 Own the warehouse layers in dbt: raw landing, staged and identity-resolved models, and the curated models that analysts, data scientists, dashboards, and internal AI agents read from. Every model has a declared grain and tests.

 Establish data contracts with product engineering and with the owners of the platforms we depend on, so an upstream change is caught at the boundary instead of silently nulling a field three models downstream. You will define these rather than inherit them.

 Own governance: role-based access, PII masking, retention, and auditability, including self-serve tools that do not become a way around permissions.

 Choose deliberately between batch, change-data-capture, and streaming, based on what each consumer actually needs.

 Partner with Marketing, Product, and Operations to get the events and fields the business needs captured. This role is measured on whether the business's numbers are right and on time, not on pipelines delivered.

 What We Value: 

 Engineers measured on whether the numbers are right, not on what was shipped

 Very high agency. Much of the work here begins before the requirement is clear: the source has no documentation, the field you need was never captured, and the team that owns it is busy shipping. We need someone who chases a dependency into another team and ships something reliable without a spec.

 Skepticism about data, including your own pipelines. Check grain, joins, and completeness before you trust a number.

 A preference for boring, observable systems over clever ones

 Clear communication with non-engineers: able to explain to a marketer why yesterday's number moved, and to negotiate a schema change with a product team the same afternoon

 Pragmatism: ship the version that works now, and improve it deliberately rather than waiting for the ideal one

 Requirements: 

 Minimum five years in data engineering or analytics engineering, with production pipelines you were on the hook for when they broke

 Deep proficiency in SQL and Python, and production experience with dbt in a layered warehouse: raw, staged, and curated models with a declared grain, tests, and incremental builds

 Hands-on experience bringing in third-party and application data through managed connectors, event pipelines, and change-data-capture, and handling what goes wrong with each: schema drift, resyncs, duplicates, and late or missing records

 Experience sending data back out, through reverse ETL, audiences, or conversion feeds, and owning its correctness after it leaves the warehouse

 Data quality in practice: reconciliation against systems of record, freshness and volume monitoring, and the fix that stops an incident from recurring

 Data governance in practice: role-based access, PII masking, retention, and an audit trail you could show a regulator

 Familiarity with fintech or brokerage data: account opening and KYC, funding and transfers, trades and settlement, and why superficially similar balance or status fields are not interchangeable

 Self-starter who operates well without a large team to escalate into

 Nice To Haves: 

 Identity resolution across web, app, and account data: anonymous visitors, multiple devices, and more than one account per person

 Marketing data: ad-platform APIs, conversion APIs, click IDs, and attribution

 Lifecycle and CRM tooling, where the pipeline ends in a campaign rather than a table

 Semantic layers for BI tools and AI agents

 Workflow orchestration (Argo Workflows, Airflow, or similar), and enough Kubernetes to debug your own jobs

 Data retention and audit requirements in a regulated environment (SEC, FINRA)

 Experience being an early data engineering hire on a team that scaled

 Scope: This role owns the data: pipelines into and out of the warehouse, the models in it, and who can see what. The trading systems, the core clearing ledger, and company infrastructure (cloud, Kubernetes, networking) are owned by engineering and infrastructure teams, and you will work closely with them.

 Active Data Stack: Snowflake, dbt, SQL, Python, Fivetran, Segment, Argo Workflows, Datadog

 We Offer: 

 The opportunity to join a small and growing team of good people, where you can make a difference.

 A new, high-quality code base with little technical debt and room to build new services and features.

 A meritocratic philosophy that champions collaboration.

 Competitive compensation, benefits, and perks.

 At Clear Street, we offer competitive compensation packages, company equity, 401k matching, gender neutral parental leave, and full medical, dental and vision insurance. In-office benefits include lunch stipends, fully stocked kitchens, happy hours, a great location, and amazing views.

 The Base Salary Range for this role is $150,000 - $250,000. 

 Our top priority is our people. We're continuously investing in a culture that promotes collaboration. We help each other through challenges and celebrate each other's successes. We believe that modern workplaces succeed by virtue of having high-performance workforces that are diverse — in ideas, in cultures, and in experiences. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and put in the effort to make such a workplace a daily reality. #LI-Remote

jobs.title: Senior / Staff Software Engineer, Reference Data Services
jobs.description:
About Clear Street:

 Clear Street’s mission is to give every sophisticated investor access to every asset, in every market, through a unified platform built for speed, transparency and scale.

We give our clients the technology, tools, and service once reserved for the largest institutions, rebuilt with modern infrastructure. Our single, cloud-native, end-to-end capital markets platform powers investor growth today and is transforming how they can interact with markets tomorrow.

 For more information, visit https://clearstreet.io .

 The Team: 

 The FACT team is responsible for several key data products which enable Clear Street’s systems and personnel to operate with confidence and speed. These products include security and pricing master, corporate actions, and streaming market data as well as a number of other key reference datasets. The FACT team takes on the task of collecting inputs from various sources including vendors, public sources, and internal teams and organizing them into cohesive data products which serve as the authoritative source of reference data within the firm.

 The services which allow this data to be accessed in a flexible and responsive manner are key to the FACT team delivering these critical datasets throughout the firm. Building these services requires thoughtful API design and the use of strategic caching and robust signaling. The accuracy and timeliness of this data are a fundamental building block of Clear Street’s platform.

 FACT Team Stack: Go, gRPC, Python, PostgreSQL, Snowflake, Kafka, Redis, Docker, Kubernetes

 The Role: 

 As an experienced Software Engineer on the FACT Team, you will work with a team of passionate and highly collaborative engineers to build out our core Platform. You will own the design and implementation of new features and services, turning the complexity of processing financial transactions across various asset classes into highly scalable services. You will tackle non trivial problems that will challenge you to flex your system design muscles, balance trade offs, and implement clean efficient code. As a voice of experience in the team, you will help mentor teammates, evolve our technical standards and best practices, and further our culture of system designs.

 Requirements: 

 You have at least eight (8) years of professional experience implementing highly scalable services (we implement our code in Golang)

 You demonstrate confidence in designing and building flexible APIs which enable a microservice architecture to reliably deliver consistent data

 You have contributed to systems that deliver solutions to complex business problems that handle massive amounts of data. You are drawn towards scale, distributed systems, and associated technologies.

 You have a strong command over object-oriented design patterns, data structures, and algorithms.

 You communicate technical ideas with ease and always look to collaborate to deliver high quality products.

 Your experience will help you mentor team members, define our engineering standards, and drive a system design approach to building new services.

 We Offer: 

 The Base Salary Range for this role is $200,000 - 250,000. This range is representative of the starting base salaries for this role at Clear Street. Where a candidate falls in this range will be based on job related factors such as relevant experience, skills, and location. This range represents Base Salary only, which is just one element of Clear Street's total compensation. The range stated does not include other factors of total compensation such as bonuses or equity.

 At Clear Street, we offer competitive compensation packages, company equity, 401k matching, gender neutral parental leave, and full medical, dental and vision insurance. Our belief has always been that we are better as a business when we are all together in person. As such, we are requiring employees to be in the office 4 days per week. In-office benefits include lunch stipends, fully stocked kitchens, happy hours, a great location, and amazing views.

 Our top priority is our people. We’re continuously investing in a culture that promotes collaboration. We help each other through challenges and celebrate each other's successes. We believe that modern workplaces succeed by virtue of having high-performance workforces that are diverse — in ideas, in cultures, and in experiences. We put in the effort to make such a workplace a daily reality and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. #LI-Hybrid

jobs.description:
𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗠𝗮𝗸𝗲𝘀 𝗖𝗹𝗼𝘂𝗱𝗯𝗲𝗱𝘀 𝗨𝗻𝗶𝗾𝘂𝗲

 At Cloudbeds , we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've continually been recognized for excellence, most recently earning top honors at the 2026 HotelTechAwards for Best Hotel Management Software and landing on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again, but we're just getting started.

 𝗢𝘂𝗿 𝗗𝗮𝘁𝗮 𝗔𝗻𝗮𝗹𝘆𝘁𝗶𝗰𝘀 & 𝗕𝗜 𝘁𝗲𝗮𝗺

 We are a small, senior, fully remote team running analytics for the entire company on Snowflake, dbt, Matillion, and Sigma. We move fast and ship things people use daily. What we're missing is a senior technical voice to make the foundational calls — architecture, platform, governance, ML Ops — so that speed compounds instead of accumulating debt. That's this role, and it comes with unusual latitude to decide how the platform should work.

 𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝗬𝗼𝘂'𝗹𝗹 𝗠𝗮𝗸𝗲 𝗮𝗻 𝗜𝗺𝗽𝗮𝗰𝘁

 As our 𝗧𝗲𝗰𝗵 𝗟𝗲𝗮𝗱 𝗗𝗮𝘁𝗮 𝗘𝗻𝗴𝗶𝗻𝗲𝗲𝗿 & 𝗗𝗮𝘁𝗮 𝗔𝗿𝗰𝗵𝗶𝘁𝗲𝗰𝘁, you will shape the technical direction, architectural standards, and data governance of our core Data Analytics platform. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will act as our Data Architect—owning logical and physical data modeling, warehouse design, and layered curation (staging → intermediate → mart)—while serving as our Data Engineering Tech Lead.

 You will help continuously modernize our tech stack, elevating our software engineering discipline across our data pipelines (DataOps/CI-CD), optimizing compute performance and costs, driving MLOps workflows, and reinforcing data quality and security standards. Crucially, you will drive our AI-readiness initiatives—architecting the semantic layers, data structures, and access patterns needed to make our data seamless and reliable for AI agents and automated workflows. You will serve as the technical anchor for a talented team of Analytical Engineers, collaborating closely with Engineering, Infrastructure, Data Science / ML and business stakeholders to ensure our data ecosystem is reliable, scalable, and business-ready.

 𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗬𝗼𝘂 𝗕𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘁𝗼 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗧𝗲𝗮𝗺

 Data Architecture & Modeling Ownership: Set and evolve our cloud data architecture on Snowflake. Own data model design across data products and marts, implementing flexible dimensional models (Star Schemas, SCDs, conformed dimensions) and documenting decisions through Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).

 Data Engineering Competency: Lead the end-to-end design and execution of data pipelines—owning ingestion, API integrations, custom connectors, ELT/ETL processes, and pipeline orchestration.

 DataOps & CI/CD Integration: Build upon our existing Git, CI/CD, and Jira workflows by embedding specialized data discipline—such as automated dbt testing on pull requests, environment isolation, automated credential management, and data deployment standards.

 Governance & Observability Strategy: Build upon and refine the initial foundations of our governance model. Evaluate, select, and implement scalable Data Catalog and Data Observability solutions to track data lineage, ensure freshness, monitor completeness, and automate failure alerting.

 Platform Efficiency & Cost Control: Continuously tune Snowflake query performance, clustering, and warehouse sizing to optimize execution times and compute spend.

 Technical Mentorship & Agile Leadership: Raise the technical effectiveness of Analytical Engineers within our Agile planning framework through architectural guidance, design reviews, and constructive challenge.

 Stack Modernization & Architecture Evolution: Continuously evaluate new tools, frameworks, and architecture patterns to modernize, optimize, and add flexibility to our data stack.

 𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗦𝗲𝘁𝘀 𝗬𝗼𝘂 𝗨𝗽 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗦𝘂𝗰𝗰𝗲𝘀𝘀

 Senior Hands-On Experience: Proven track record as a Senior Data Engineer, Data Architect, or Tech Lead in cloud data environments.

 AI & Agent Readiness: Exposure to preparing data structures, semantic models, feature stores, and API/access layers for AI agents, machine learning pipelines, and automated LLM workflows.

 Snowflake & dbt Mastery: Deep hands-on expertise administering, tuning, and modeling in Snowflake, alongside advanced mastery of dbt (macros, incremental models, custom tests, packages, and dbt-native CI/CD testing).

 Advanced SQL & Python Skills: Expert analytical SQL skills (query execution plan tuning, window functions, CTEs) and strong Python proficiency for data pipelines, scripting, and MLOps workflows.

 Orchestration & Tool Evaluation: Practical experience with ingestion and orchestration engines (e.g., Matillion, Apache Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, Fivetran), with a strong ability to evaluate architectural trade-offs, performance, and costs when selecting or migrating platforms.

 DataOps & Software Engineering Discipline: Experience operating with active Git and CI/CD pipelines, with a track record of extending these systems to include automated data testing, deployment validation, and secure credential rotation.

 Critical Thinking & Problem Decomposition: Tendency to question assumptions, gather full business context, form hypotheses, and rigorously evaluate outputs (especially for AI/ML outputs) before jumping to technical solutions.

 Pragmatic Experimentation: Passion for building lightweight MVPs and Proofs of Concept (POCs) to evaluate new technologies, test architectural hypotheses, and modernize the data stack.

 Communication & Technical Influence: Business-level English fluency with the ability to articulate complex technical trade-offs clearly, mentor teammates, and collaborate effectively in a remote, globally distributed team.

 𝗕𝗼𝗻𝘂𝘀 𝗦𝗸𝗶𝗹𝗹𝘀 𝘁𝗼 𝗦𝘁𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗢𝘂𝘁

 Exposure to applied AI tooling (Snowflake Cortex, AI Classify, RAG workflows, LLM agents, MCP servers).

 Familiarity with modern BI consumption tools like Sigma or workflow engines like n8n.

 #LI-SD1

 Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ team members across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, hoteliers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle. Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in tech who are obsessed with using AI to transform a trillion-dollar industry, this is your chance to be part of something extraordinary.

 Overall 10 Best Places to Work | HotelTechAwards (2026)

 Most Loved Workplace® Certified (2024)

 Deloitte Technology Fast 500 (2024)

 Remote First, Remote Always

 PTO in accordance with local labor requirements

 Home office stipend based on country of residency

 Professional development courses in Cloudbeds University

 Access to professional development, including manager training, upskilling, and knowledge transfer

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
About Clutch 

 Clutch is Canada’s largest online used car retailer, delivering a seamless, hassle-free car buying and selling experience to drivers everywhere. Customers can browse hundreds of cars from the comfort of their home, get the right one delivered to their door, and enjoy peace of mind with our 10-Day Money-Back Guarantee… and that’s just the beginning.

 Named one of Canada's top growing Companies two years in a row and also awarded a spot on LinkedIn's Top Canadian Startups list, we're looking to add curious, hard-working, and driven individuals to our growing team.

 Headquartered in Toronto, Clutch was founded in 2017. Clutch is backed by a number of world-class investors, including Canaan, BrandProject, Real Ventures, D1 Capital, and Upper90. To learn more, visit clutch.ca

 About the role 

 At Clutch, we believe advances in AI are fundamentally changing how great products are built. Traditional handoffs between product, design, and engineering are giving way to smaller, faster teams where builders can take ideas from concept to production in days instead of months.

 As a Senior Data Engineer, you'll own the data platform that powers decision-making across Clutch, from how we buy and price vehicles, to how customers move through our funnel, to how we deliver and finance cars. The pipelines, models, and infrastructure you build will be the foundation our analysts and data scientists rely on every day, including for our fast-growing financial services work.

 Our data engineers don't just move data, they own outcomes. That means working directly with stakeholders to understand what they need, designing systems that scale with the business, and making sure the data behind every important decision is reliable, well-modeled, and easy to use. If you see a broken pipeline or a question the data can't answer yet and feel compelled to fix it, you'll thrive at Clutch.

 Technology at Clutch 

 We believe great engineers can learn great technology.

 Our data team builds with technologies like Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, Python, and AWS, alongside an application stack of TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and Express. We're far more interested in exceptional engineers than perfect technology matches. If you've built outstanding data platforms in another modern stack and are excited to learn, improve, and help evolve ours, we'd love to talk.

 What you'll do 

 Own Clutch's data platform end-to-end, designing and evolving the architecture behind our warehouse, pipelines, and data models with long-term scalability in mind.

 Build reliable, well-tested ELT pipelines that bring together data from our applications, operational systems, and third-party tools.

 Design data models in partnership with analysts and data scientists so that trusted, well-structured data is easy to find and use across the business.

 Build the data foundations for our financial services work, partnering closely with the data scientist focused on that area to support modeling, experimentation, and analytics.

 Own data quality and observability, with monitoring, testing, and alerting that catch issues before stakeholders do.

 Apply strong DevOps practices to data, including version control, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and automated deployments.

 Use AI as part of your everyday engineering workflow to prototype, accelerate development, and improve code quality.

 Make thoughtful technical decisions that balance speed, cost, quality, and maintainability, and continuously evaluate new tools that help the team move faster.

 Establish data standards, documentation, and governance practices as our platform matures.

 Mentor others and raise the bar for data engineering across the team through design discussions and code reviews.

 What we're looking for 

 5+ years of experience in data engineering or a closely related field.

 Have built and operated production data pipelines and platforms that people rely on.

 Advanced SQL and strong programming skills in Python (TypeScript is a plus).

 Hands-on experience with a modern cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift.

 Experience with transformation and orchestration tools such as dbt and Airflow.

 Experience with cloud platforms, ideally AWS, and their data services.

 Strong data modeling skills, including designing for analytics use cases.

 Experience with DevOps and observability tooling such as Git, GitHub Actions, Docker, Terraform, and Datadog.

 Use AI as a force multiplier to explore ideas, prototype solutions, and accelerate development.

 Enjoy working directly with stakeholders to understand problems and deliver business value.

 Communicate clearly and are comfortable making decisions in ambiguous environments.

 Care as much about business outcomes as technical excellence.

 Nice to Have 

 Experience with streaming or event-driven data (e.g., Kafka, Kinesis).

 Experience supporting data science or ML workflows in production.

 Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, automotive, or fintech.

 Why you'll love it at Clutch 

 Autonomy & ownership: create your own path and own your work

 Competitive compensation and equity incentives

 Generous time off program

 Health & dental benefits

 Employment Type 

 New, Permanent Full-Time

 Hybrid, Downtown Toronto three days a week

 Compensation & Benefits 

 Salary: $160,000 - 200,000

 Equity incentives

 Comprehensive healthcare, dental, vision, prescriptions, life insurance, and dependent coverage

 Pay reflects skills, performance, market benchmarking, responsibilities, and working conditions

 Clutch is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all individuals have an opportunity to succeed. If you require accommodation at any stage of the interview process, please email talent@clutch.ca

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Data Products
jobs.description:
At Counterpart Health, we are transforming healthcare and improving patient care with our innovative primary care tool, Counterpart Assistant. By supporting Primary Care Physicians (PCPs), we are able to deliver improved outcomes to our patients at a lower cost through early diagnosis and longitudinal care management of chronic conditions.

 We're looking for a Director of Engineering to lead our Data Products pillar, serving as the technical engine for Counterpart Health's (CPH) clinical-data foundation. You will own the technical strategy and execution for the Data Products roadmap—encompassing clinical data ingestion, canonical data modeling, and ingestion scalability—while building scalable, reusable data capabilities that serve as a foundational platform for driving clinical insight generation. You will own the technical strategy for our Data Products platform—ensuring our clinical data foundations (using standards like FHIR, LOINC, and RxNorm) effectively drive business outcomes. You will serve as a critical leader and partner to the VP of Engineering and cross-functional leaders in Product, Data Science, and Design.

 As a Director of Engineering, Data Products , you will: 

 Own the Data Products technical roadmap, canonical data modeling, and ingestion scalability.

 Manage and optimize the clinical data ingestion pipeline.

 Oversee the scaling of customer data onboarding processes and the continuous improvement of data hygiene, canonical storage standards, and observability and monitoring of the data pipelines.

 Enable shared funnel visibility across the organization and support the development of a robust enterprise reporting framework.

 Drive the adoption of an AI-powered Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), leveraging AI tools to accelerate coding, testing, and deployment processes while maintaining stringent code quality and security standards. 

 Success in this role looks like: 

 Successfully achieving improved clinical data coverage and freshness targets across all patient populations.

 Predictable and repeatable multi-customer scaling with standardized playbooks for rapid data readiness.

 Broad adoption of the Data Products platform and its capabilities

 Data infrastructure is robust, stable, and serves as a reliable source of truth during rapid organizational growth and customer expansion.

 You should get in touch if: 

 You possess 10+ years of engineering experience with a deep focus on building high-scale data platforms, distributed systems, and interoperability standards (e.g., FHIR, CCDA).

 Proven track record in managing and scaling engineering teams that handle data-heavy workloads and complex clinical data pipelines.

 Proven experience leading cross-functional teams of engineers to deliver complex software in regulated environments. 

 Experience implementing and scaling AI-assisted development workflows (e.g., AI code assistants, automated testing, or AI-driven SDLC) to improve engineering productivity.

 Demonstrated experience building and managing engineering systems in highly regulated healthcare environments, with a strong operational understanding of HIPAA and SOC 2 compliance requirements.

 Passionate about the healthcare sector and committed to utilizing technical expertise to drive meaningful improvements in patient outcomes.

 Deeply familiar with the inherent complexities and lack of standardization in clinical datasets, with a proactive focus on enhancing data integrity.

 Motivated by intricate technical challenges and dedicated to architecting pragmatic, high-quality engineering solutions through continuous intellectual exploration.

 Thrives in dynamic, high-growth environments, demonstrating the ability to navigate ambiguity and align technical priorities with overarching strategic objectives.

 Action-oriented leader who assumes full ownership of system sustainability, willing to address operational gaps to ensure the team achieves its delivery milestones.

 Engineering Leadership Skills: 

 Proven track record of directly hiring, mentoring, and developing engineering managers, Tech Leads (TLs), and Principal Engineers (PELs).

 Demonstrated ability to cultivate a high-performance engineering culture focused on velocity, quality, and psychological safety.

 Experience leading organizational change, including structural re-orgs and process evolution.

 Strong proficiency in strategic resource allocation, capacity planning, and managing technical debt in a fast-paced product environment.

 Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex technical constraints into clear, actionable business strategies (e.g., impact on HEDIS/RADV outcomes) for non-technical leadership.

 Benefits Overview :

 Financial Well-Being : Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions.

 Physical Well-Being : We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive group medical coverage that include coverage for hospitalization, outpatient care, optical services, and dental benefits.

 Mental Well-Being : We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous annual leave policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location. 

 Professional Development : We are committed to developing our talent professionally. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews.

 Additional Perks :

 Reimbursement for office setup expenses

 Monthly cell phone & internet stipend

 Flexibility to work from home, enabling collaboration with global teams

 Paid parental leave for all new parents

 And much more!

 About Counterpart Health: In 2018, Clover Health set out to do something unprecedented: build a clinically intuitive, AI-enabled solution that fits within physicians' workflows to help support the earlier diagnosis and management of chronic conditions.

 Years later, that vision is a reality, with thousands of practitioners using Counterpart Assistant during patient visits to improve disease management, reduce medical expenses, and drive success in value-based care.

 With an exceptional team of value-based care and technology experts, Counterpart Health is driving value-based care at the speed of software.

 Counterpart Health is a subsidiary of Clover Health. From Clover’s inception, Diversity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, perspectives, opinions, and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employee’s points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

jobs.title: Senior Database Reliability Engineer - DBRE
jobs.description:
What Cognite is: Relentless to achieve 

 Cognite operates at the forefront of industrial digitalization, building AI , and data solutions that solve the world’s hardest, highest-impact problems. With unmatched industrial heritage and a comprehensive suite of AI capabilities, including low-code AI agents, Cognite accelerates the digital transformation to drive operational improvements. 

 We thrive in challenges. We challenge assumptions. We execute with speed and ownership. If you view obstacles as signals to step forward - not backwards - you’ll feel right at home here. 

 Our Moonshot is bold: Unlock $100B in customer value by 2035, and redefine how global industry works. Join us in this venture where AI and data meet ingenuity, and together, we will forge the path to a smarter, more connected industrial future. 

 About the Role 

 We are looking for a Senior Database Reliability Engineer (DBRE) to join our Cloud deployment team and take ownership of the reliability, scalability, automation, and operational excellence of our core database infrastructure.

 You will work across PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, and Kafka , supporting a multi-cloud, Kubernetes-based platform at significant scale. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex infrastructure and database challenges, eliminating operational toil, and building highly automated systems.

 You will partner closely with Software Engineering, SRE, Platform Engineering, and Product teams to ensure our data platforms are highly available, scalable, secure, and resilient.

 What You’ll Own 

 Managed PostgreSQL Fleet Orchestration 

 Standardize and automate the lifecycle management of a fleet of 1000+ PostgreSQL instances across Azure, AWS, and GCP.

 Build and maintain infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation frameworks.

 Automate provisioning, configuration, patching, upgrades, backups, and operational workflows.

 Improve consistency and reliability across our PostgreSQL fleet while reducing manual operational effort.

 Work with cloud-managed PostgreSQL services including Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Flexible Server, Amazon RDS, and GCP Cloud SQL .

 Evolve our provisioning and configuration approach using Kubernetes-based and Terraform-driven workflows.

 Hybrid Elasticsearch Operations 

 Design, operate, and scale high-performance Elasticsearch clusters across Elastic Cloud (SaaS) and ECK (self-managed Kubernetes) environments.

 Own the reliability and performance of Elasticsearch infrastructure supporting search, semantic retrieval, vector workloads, and high-volume operational data.

 Establish best practices around cluster sizing, capacity planning, shard management, upgrades, backups, monitoring, and disaster recovery.

 Support Elasticsearch deployments where PostgreSQL is the source of truth as well as environments where Elasticsearch is the authoritative datastore .

 Build automation to simplify provisioning and lifecycle management across Elastic Cloud and ECK.

 Help improve security, connectivity, zone awareness, and operational resilience across multi-cloud deployments.

 Kafka Streaming Infrastructure 

 Own the reliability, scalability, and performance of Kafka clusters supporting high-throughput, low-latency event streaming across the platform.

 Operate Kafka in both self-managed (Kubernetes-based, e.g. Strimzi/Kafka Operator) and managed (e.g. Confluent Cloud, MSK) configurations across multi-cloud environments.

 Drive capacity planning, partition and topic design, replication strategy, and broker-level performance tuning.

 Establish and automate best practices around upgrades, rolling restarts, backups/disaster recovery, and schema evolution (e.g. Schema Registry).

 Build monitoring and alerting for consumer lag, broker health, ISR status, and throughput to enable early incident detection.

 Partner with Software Engineering to ensure producer/consumer patterns, retention policies, and topic ownership scale cleanly as usage grows.

 What You Bring 

 6+ years of experience in Database Reliability Engineering, Database Engineering, SRE, Platform Engineering, or a closely related role.

 Strong hands-on experience operating PostgreSQL at scale , preferably in cloud-managed environments.

 Strong experience with Elasticsearch , including cluster administration, performance tuning, scaling, shard management, and troubleshooting.

 Experience operating databases and stateful workloads on Kubernetes .

 Experience with Kafka or another distributed database/storage system is highly valuable.

 Strong Infrastructure as Code experience with Terraform or similar tools.

 Experience with at least one major cloud platform — Azure, AWS, or GCP — with exposure to multi-cloud environments preferred.

 Strong understanding of database reliability principles including high availability, disaster recovery, backups, replication, capacity planning, and observability.

 Proficiency in scripting or programming using Python, Go, or a similar language .

 Experience automating repetitive operational tasks and building self-service infrastructure.

 Strong troubleshooting and incident-management skills, with the ability to diagnose complex distributed-system failures.

 Good to Have 

 Experience with Kafka and fdb-kubernetes-operator .

 Experience with Elastic Cloud and ECK .

 Proficiency in Go for building automation, tooling, or operators; Python or another scripting language is a plus. 

 Experience managing PostgreSQL through Kubernetes operators or custom resources.

 Experience with Kubernetes operators and building automation for stateful workloads.

 Experience operating databases across multi-cloud and private-cloud environments .

 Experience with observability platforms and database performance monitoring.

 Familiarity with distributed systems, data replication, consistency, and failure-domain design.

 What Success Looks Like 

 Database provisioning and lifecycle operations become highly automated and repeatable.

 Operational toil across PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, and Kafka is significantly reduced.

 Database platforms can scale reliably with business and customer growth.

 Incidents are detected early and resolved through strong automation and observability.

 Database infrastructure is consistent and resilient across Azure, AWS, GCP, and private-cloud environments.

 Engineering teams can consume reliable database infrastructure without requiring significant manual DBRE intervention.

 Why This Role? 

 This is an opportunity to work on large-scale, distributed data infrastructure at the heart of a modern Knowledge Graph platform. You will have significant ownership across three critical database technologies and will play a key role in making our data infrastructure more automated, reliable, and scalable.

 Learn more about us 

 Impact 2025

 We’re globally recognized domain experts with an international presence that spans Phoenix, Houston, Oslo Tokyo, Bengaluru, and Abu Dhabi. 

 Equal Opportunity 

 Cognite is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment at work and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive the same level of consideration for employment.

 About the role 

 As a Staff Data Engineer on Coalition’s Data team, you will define the architecture and technical direction of the enterprise Data & Analytics platform. You will build trusted, scalable data infrastructure for cyber security, insurance exposure analytics, BI, actuarial workflows, and AI/ML products. Your work will help Coalition make better risk decisions, deliver reliable data products, and scale its mission to Protect the Unprotected.

 Responsibilities 

 Set the architecture and engineering standards for Snowflake, dbt, orchestration, streaming, batch ELT, and infrastructure-as-code across the Data platform.

 Design governed Medallion pipelines and domain-oriented data models that make complex insurance and security data reliable, discoverable, and usable.

 Build reusable data products, contracts, feature stores, and semantic models that serve BI, actuarial, AI/ML, and operational consumers.

 Establish observability, quality, lineage, security, and incident-management practices that protect data reliability and support regulated workflows.

 Develop the platform foundations for feature engineering, embeddings, vector search, and retrieval-augmented AI applications.

 Partner with engineering, product, underwriting, actuarial, security, and business teams to align architecture with customer and business outcomes.

 Skills and Qualifications 

 9–12 years of experience building and operating production data platforms, with a track record of owning architecture for complex or high-scale systems.

 Deep expertise in Snowflake and dbt, including performance optimization, incremental processing, warehouse cost management, testing, and deployment practices.

 Strong programming and data modeling skills in Python and analytical SQL, with experience designing dimensional models and/or Data Vault 2.0 architectures.

 Experience building reliable batch and streaming pipelines with modern orchestration and ingestion technologies such as Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, Kafka, Kinesis, Snowpipe Streaming, or Dynamic Tables.

 Experience establishing data products, data contracts, domain ownership, SLAs, access controls, lineage, and quality standards across multiple teams.

 Experience building feature engineering infrastructure or AI data systems, including feature stores, embeddings, vector search, or RAG pipelines.

 Production experience with Looker and LookML, including governed semantic models and centralized metrics for self-service analytics.

 A strong technical leadership mindset, with experience influencing architecture across teams, mentoring engineers, communicating tradeoffs, and creating durable engineering standards.

 Bonus Points 

 Experience modeling insurance domains such as underwriting, claims, reinsurance, policy exposure, loss runs, or loss triangles.

 Familiarity with Snowflake Cortex, Feast, DataHub, Atlan, OpenLineage, Elementary, dbt-expectations, or Evidently AI.

 Experience implementing RBAC hierarchies, row-level policies, column masking, PII tokenization, audit logging, or regulated-data controls.

 Experience managing Snowflake environments with Terraform and CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions.

 Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor or GitHub Copilot to improve code quality, testing, and documentation.

 Compensation

 As a remote-first organization, our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several Canadian geographic markets. 

 In Alberta, British Columbia & Ontario the base salary for this position ranges from $158,000/year up to $218,000/year. 

 For all other locations, the base salary for this position ranges from $142,600/year up to $200,000/year. 

 Consistent with applicable laws, an employee's pay within this range is based on a number of factors, which include but are not limited to relevant education, skills, job-related knowledge, qualifications, work experience, credentials, and/or geographic location. Your Recruiter can share more on the specific target salary range for your location during the interview process. Coalition, Inc. reserves the right to modify this range as needed.

 Application Updates: Consistent with our commitment to transparency, if you are interviewed for this role, we will provide a status update on your application within 45 days of your final interview.

 Perks

 100% medical, dental, and vision coverage

 Flexible PTO

 Annual home office stipend and WeWork access

 Mental & physical health wellness programs like Headspace, Lumino, and more!

 Competitive compensation and opportunity for advancement

 Why Coalition? 

 Work at Coalition is centered on the joint mission to Protect the Unprotected. We have built a remote-first, highly inclusive culture that welcomes people from diverse backgrounds. We trust each other to take responsibility, share ownership of outcomes, and put in the work together to protect businesses from digital risk. Coalition’s exceptional growth stems from its ability to address real-world problems for organizations of all sizes while remaining true to our founding values of character, humility, responsibility, purpose, authenticity, and inclusion.

 We’re always looking for collaborative, inquisitive individuals to join #OurCoalition.

 Visit our Newsroom > 

 Privacy Notice 

 Coalition is committed to protecting your privacy and handling your personal information responsibly. We collect, use, and store personal information as necessary for the recruitment process and in compliance with applicable privacy laws and regulations in all regions where we operate. We want you to understand what personal information we collect, how we use it, and your rights regarding access, correction, and deletion of your data where applicable. Information submitted, collected, and processed as part of your application is subject to Coalition's Privacy Policy. For further details, please review our full Privacy Policy or contact us with any questions regarding how your information is handled.

 Our Privacy Policy > 

 Safe Hiring Notice 

 All legitimate communication from Coalition comes from @coalitioninc.com emails, and open roles are listed only on our Careers page . We never ask for payment, banking details, or personal identification before an offer is accepted through our secure systems. If you believe you’ve been a victim of fraudulent recruiting, follow guidance from the Federal Trade Commission (FTC).

 Anti-Discrimination Notice 

 Coalition is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Our policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all individuals, without discrimination or harassment on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable laws in each country where we operate. This commitment includes, but is not limited to, ensuring equal treatment in recruitment, selection, training, promotion, transfer, compensation, and all other aspects of employment. Coalition does not tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, and we are dedicated to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace.

 Accommodations 

 Coalition is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities, including applicants and employees, in accordance with applicable laws and regulations in each country where we operate. Our policy is to support equal opportunity in the hiring process by considering qualified applicants regardless of disability or other protected characteristics, unless providing accommodation would impose an undue hardship or disproportionate burden. If you require accommodation to complete an application, interview, pre-employment testing, or participate in the selection process, please contact us at candidateaccommodations@coalitioninc.com . We also consider all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in line with applicable laws and regulations in each jurisdiction.

 To all recruitment agencies: Coalition does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Do not forward resumes to our email alias, employees, or other physical or virtual organization locations. Coalition is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Recruitment Fraud Alert 

 We’ve learned that scammers are impersonating Commvault team members—including HR and leadership—via email or text. These bad actors may conduct fake interviews and ask for personal information, such as your social security number. 

 What to know: 

 Commvault does not conduct interviews by email or text.

 We will never ask you to submit sensitive documents (including banking information, SSN, etc) before your first day.

 Commvault recruiters may contact prospective candidates through LinkedIn and other professional networking platforms regarding career opportunities. If you are unsure whether a recruiting communication is legitimate, review the profile to ensure they have a badge verifying them as a Commvault employee.

 If you suspect a recruiting scam, please contact us at wwrecruitingteam@commvault.com 

 About Commvault 

 Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) delivers continuous recovery for the AI era. We help organizations stay ready for constant disruption by returning critical data, applications, identities, and AI systems to a clean, trusted state. Our purpose-built recovery solutions span cloud-native and hybrid environments, leveraging AI to enable resilience at enterprise scale.

 Data Engineer (Platform Engineering Focus) 

 The Opportunity: 

 The Platform Engineer builds, automates, and supports the shared cloud platform services that enable reliable data, analytics, and AI delivery.
This hands-on role works with Senior Platform Engineers, Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, Security, and Architecture teams to provision environments, implement deployment automation, monitor platform health, resolve incidents, and improve the developer experience.

 What you’ll do…

 Platform Build & Operations 

 Provision and configure Databricks, Azure Data Lake, Microsoft Fabric, and supporting cloud resources using approved patterns.

 Maintain workspace, compute, storage, identity, access, secrets, and environment configurations.

 Execute platform upgrades, configuration changes, maintenance activities, and production deployments.

 Support environment readiness for data engineering, analytics, governance, and AI teams.

 Automation & CI/CD 

 Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code modules, deployment scripts, and CI/CD pipelines.

 Automate repeatable administrative, monitoring, access, and environment-management tasks.

 Maintain source-control, branching, release, artifact, and environment-promotion processes.

 Contribute to self-service templates and reusable engineering components.

 Monitoring, Support & Optimization 

 Monitor platform availability, performance, capacity, security events, and job health.

 Respond to incidents and service requests; troubleshoot issues and document root causes and resolutions.

 Maintain operational dashboards, alerts, runbooks, knowledge articles, and support procedures.

 Identify and implement opportunities to improve reliability, performance, and cloud cost efficiency.

 Security, Governance & Collaboration 

 Apply approved identity, access, networking, logging, classification, and audit controls.

 Support integration with Unity Catalog, Microsoft Purview, and enterprise security services.

 Work with engineering and analytics teams to resolve platform dependencies and remove delivery blockers.

 Participate in design reviews, sprint planning, testing, documentation, and continuous-improvement activities.

 Who you are? 

 3+ years of experience in cloud engineering, DevOps, platform operations, data platform support, or a related role.

 Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure and familiarity with Databricks or a comparable data platform.

 Experience with infrastructure as code, CI/CD pipelines, source control, and deployment automation.

 Working knowledge of cloud networking, identity and access management, storage, compute, monitoring, and security concepts.

 Scripting experience using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or a comparable language.

 Strong troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and collaboration skills.

 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field; equivalent practical experience will be considered.

 Preferred Qualifications 

 Experience with Terraform, Bicep, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Unity Catalog, Microsoft Fabric, or Microsoft Purview.

 Familiarity with lakehouse, Spark, SQL, data pipelines, and AI/ML platform workloads.

 Cloud or Databricks certification.

 Experience working in Agile or product-oriented delivery teams.

jobs.description:
What The Role Is 

 We are seeking a Senior Analyst, Analytics Engineering to bridge the gap between business questions and trusted data. You’ll work directly with stakeholders, first and foremost our asset managers, along with our Commercial Analytics (CA) and Market Optimization and Trading (MOT) teams and partners in finance, accounting, procurement, and operations, to understand what they need, build the data models that answer it, and deliver the reports, dashboards, and light predictive analyses that put it to use.

 The role’s initial workload is expected to be roughly one-third each: (1) revenue analytics and stakeholder reporting; (2) modeling SAP data across accounting, procurement, and operations and maintenance (O&M) to serve teams across the organization; and (3) monthly curtailment reporting in support of the Commercial Analytics manager. Priorities may shift with business needs. This is a hands-on, hybrid role (3 days in office) that combines data analysis (Python, data visualization, requirements gathering) with analytics engineering (SQL, dbt, version control, documentation) on a modern stack: Snowflake, dbt, Hex, Streamlit, and GitLab.

 This role is suited to an analyst who has independently delivered reliable business reporting and analytical solutions, brings strong SQL, dbt, and Python skills, and wants to expand their ownership of data modeling and analytics engineering while working closely with business stakeholders.

 This role is located in our Scottsdale, AZ office.

 What You'll Be Doing 

 Requirements Gathering & Stakeholder Partnership

 Partner first and foremost with asset managers, and with Commercial Analytics (CA), Market Optimization and Trading (MOT), commercial, finance, accounting, procurement, and operations stakeholders to translate business questions into clear requirements, metric definitions, and deliverables

 Manage a backlog of reporting and analysis requests, prioritizing with your manager and communicating scope, timelines, and tradeoffs

 Present findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences in clear, concise language

 Revenue Analytics, Reporting & Data Visualization (~1/3)

 Develop analyses and reporting on revenue and related commercial and trading performance metrics, including variance and trend analysis

 Design, build, and maintain reporting dashboards and self-service data applications (e.g., Hex, Streamlit) that give stakeholders reliable, timely access to key metrics

 Apply sound visualization practices so that insights are clear, accurate, and actionable

 Support recurring and ad hoc reporting requests, including requests from senior management

 SAP Data Modeling & Analytics Engineering (~1/3)

 Develop and maintain dbt models that transform raw data into well-structured, business-ready datasets (staging, intermediate, and mart layers)

 Model SAP data in Snowflake for accounting (e.g., GL, cost centers, WBS), procurement (e.g., purchase orders, invoices, vendors), and O&M (e.g., work orders, maintenance cost) reporting that serves teams across the organization; translate SAP structures into intuitive, documented analytical models

 Work with finance, accounting, procurement, and O&M subject-matter experts to define data mappings and reconciliation rules

 Write clear, performant SQL for Snowflake, following team conventions and Snowflake best practices

 Implement dbt data tests and source freshness checks to validate data quality and timeliness, including reconciliation of analytical models to SAP source totals

 Use Git and GitLab for version control and code review of analytics code

 Curtailment Reporting & Commercial Analytics Support (~1/3)

 Apply established, site-specific curtailment methodologies to produce monthly curtailment reports for the wind, solar, and solar-plus-storage fleet, including reruns and backfills, and prepare reports for review and release by the Commercial Analytics manager

 Validate input data and results before release, including prediction error, missing or stuck values, timestamp coverage, and dispatch data

 Troubleshoot failed runs and improve the reliability, automation, and documentation of reporting scripts

 Scripting & Light Predictive Analytics

 Use Python to automate data preparation, build analysis scripts, and prototype lightweight forecasting and statistical models (e.g., regression, simple time-series, trend and anomaly detection)

 Use approved AI coding tools to accelerate SQL and Python development, reviewing, testing, and validating all generated code and outputs before they reach production or stakeholders

 Partner with senior team members to move validated prototypes into maintained, documented workflows

 Documentation & Data Governance

 Create and maintain model documentation, metric definitions, data dictionaries, and onboarding materials so that data assets are discoverable and understandable

 Follow Clearway data classification and access-control standards, handling sensitive commercial and financial data appropriately in all analyses, tools, and outputs

 Flag data quality issues early and work with data engineering and source-system owners to resolve root causes

 What You'll Bring 

 Experience and Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related quantitative field, with 3+ years of relevant experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or analytics engineering, including a track record of independently delivering reliable analytical work

 SQL: Strong SQL skills, including joins, window functions, CTEs, and query optimization; experience with a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake preferred)

 dbt: Hands-on experience building and maintaining dbt models, including dbt data tests and documentation

 Data Modeling: Working knowledge of dimensional modeling and analytics-ready data structures

 Python: Proficiency in Python for data analysis and scripting (e.g., pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Plotly)

 Version Control: Hands-on experience with Git, including branching, pull/merge requests, and code review

 AI-Assisted Development: Ability to use approved AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Snowflake Cortex Code) responsibly, with appropriate code review, testing, validation of results, and protection of sensitive data

 Excel: Strong Excel skills for building, reviewing, and quality-checking report workbooks

 Data Visualization: Experience building dashboards and reports in a modern BI or visualization tool (e.g., Hex, Power BI, Tableau, Spotfire, or Streamlit)

 Requirements Gathering: Demonstrated ability to work with business stakeholders to clarify ambiguous requests and deliver the right outcome

 Documentation: Commitment to clear documentation of data models, metrics, and analyses

 Communication: Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences

 Work Style: Self-directed, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities; able to work in the Scottsdale office 3 days per week

 What Would Be Nice 

 Experience modeling data from SAP or a comparable ERP (e.g., Oracle, NetSuite, Workday) for accounting, procurement, or maintenance reporting

 Experience with high-frequency (e.g., 1- to 5-minute) time-series data or renewable operational data, such as SCADA or historian data, power curves, or availability calculations

 Familiarity with curtailment, PPA terms, ISO/RTO markets (e.g., CAISO, ERCOT), or LMP data

 Experience in the energy, utilities, or financial services industries, including energy markets, trading, asset performance, or O&M data

 Experience with revenue, financial, or commercial analytics

 dbt Analytics Engineering Certification

 Exposure to workflow orchestration tools (e.g., Dagster, Airflow)

 Experience with forecasting or predictive modeling (e.g., scikit-learn, statsmodels)

 Experience building data apps with Streamlit.
