 You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.

 You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

 Sezzle’s Technology Stack: 

 Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python

 Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native

 Backend: Golang

 Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch

 DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes

 Version Control: Git

 Experience with infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD systems such as Terraform, GitLab CI/CD, Kubernetes, Helm, or similar tooling.

 Experience with fintech, payments, banking, e-commerce, or other high-volume transactional systems.

 Experience with database access governance, audit logging, secrets management, encryption, IAM authentication, and least-privilege access models.

The salary range for this role is $4,500 - $6,000 per month (Gross in USD) 

 About Sezzle: 

 With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

 About the Role: 

 We are seeking a talented and motivated, best-in-class Senior Data Engineer. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. This position will own the data pipelines, transformations, and reporting processes that support accurate, complete, and timely furnishing of customer account information to credit bureaus.

 This role presents an opportunity to work in a fast-paced, high growth environment while taking hands-on ownership of a critical customer-facing data function. You will dig into account data and code, debug SQL and Python workflows, and carry issues from investigation through verified resolution. You will partner with Customer Service to resolve technical dispute escalations, with Compliance to apply approved reporting requirements, and with Engineering when a fix is needed in production services or the consumer app. We are looking for an independent problem solver who can manage recurring reporting operations while improving the systems behind them.

 What You’ll Do: 

 Own recurring credit bureau furnishing operations, including data preparation, validation, submissions, bureau feedback, exception resolution, and reconciliation 

 Build, maintain, and debug SQL transformations, Python scripts, and data pipelines that produce credit reporting data

 Trace discrepancies from account activity and source records through transformation logic to furnished outputs; identify root causes and implement lasting fixes 

 Investigate escalations from Customer Service, explain what happened to account data and what should be reported under approved policies, and provide evidence to support their dispute responses 

 Identify all accounts affected by reporting defects, implement corrections and controlled reprocessing, and verify the resulting reporting outcomes 

 Develop automated tests, reconciliations, monitoring, and alerts to catch inaccurate, incomplete, duplicate, or unexpected reporting before submission 

 Partner with Engineering on defects in production services or the consumer app, providing reproducible examples, affected-account analysis, and clear requirements; validate fixes through the reporting pipeline 

 Work with Compliance to translate approved reporting requirements into technical rules and escalate ambiguous reporting scenarios 

 Document reporting logic, data lineage, procedures, and incident resolutions so the process is repeatable and can be supported by others 

 What We Look For: 

 Degree in computer science, engineering, data science, or a related quantitative discipline

 5+ years of relevant experience in data engineering or software engineering, including hands-on ownership of production data pipelines and operational workflows

 Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, account-level reconciliation, data profiling, and troubleshooting transformation logic

 Strong Python skills, including the ability to read unfamiliar code, debug existing scripts, and implement maintainable fixes

 Demonstrated ability to independently investigate ambiguous problems, prioritize recurring operations and incidents, and carry issues through to verified resolution 

 Experience with version control, code review, automated testing, monitoring, and safe deployment and reprocessing of data workflows

 Excellent problem-solving skills, with a track record of tracing data defects across systems and preventing recurrence

 Strong business judgment and communication skills; able to explain technical findings to Customer Service and Compliance and work effectively with Engineering 

 Fluent in English

 Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

 Preferred Knowledge and Skills: 

 Experience with credit reporting dispute workflows, e-OSCAR, Metro 2 format, and investigating escalations from customer support teams

 Experience with dbt, Redshift, PostgreSQL, AWS, and workflow scheduling or orchestration tools

 Experience in consumer lending, servicing, payments, financial services, banking, fintech, or BNPL

 The Tech You’ll Work With: 

 Python

 Redshift, PostgreSQL

 Data build tool (dbt) 

 WS, G Suite, Mac

 Coding agents Claude, ChatGPT

 Interview Process: 

 Application submitted (you are here)

 Wonderlic test (30-40 min)

 Interview with recruiters (30 min)

 Online coding assessment focused on SQL, Python, and debugging

 Verbal case study interview. Walk through a credit reporting discrepancy, trace the data and code, and explain how you would correct and prevent the issue.

 Verbal behavioral interview. Share examples of independently resolving data incidents, improving reliability, and partnering with Engineering and Customer Service.

 Offer

 About You: 

 You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.

 You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things

 You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.

 You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

 You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.

 You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

 What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome? 

 At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

 #Li-remote #Full-time

 Develop migration documentation, runbooks, status reports, and operational procedures.

 Ensure data integrity, availability, security, and compliance throughout the migration lifecycle.

 Must-Have Skills

jobs.description:
Learning & Development Partner – Data Engineering Business 

 Experience: 10–13 Years

 Role Purpose 

 The Learning & Development Partner will work closely with the Data Engineering business leadership to design, drive, and deliver learning strategies that build critical technical capability, leadership depth, and future-ready skills. This role acts as a strategic partner to the business, ensuring learning directly enables business growth, delivery excellence, and talent readiness.

 Key Responsibilities 

 Business Partnership & Strategy 

 Partner with Data Engineering leaders to understand business priorities, capability gaps, and future skill needs.

 Translate business goals into structured learning roadmaps covering technical, leadership, and behavioral competencies.

 Develop and execute an AI capability-building roadmap for employees, aligned with business priorities and emerging technology trends.

 Act as a trusted advisor to leaders on talent development and skill readiness.

 Technical and Capability Development 

 Design and curate learning interventions for Data Engineering roles.

 Leverage internal Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) and external partners to create high-impact, contextual learning programs.

 Ensure learning pathways are role-based, progressive, and aligned to career growth.

 Leverage AI tools for content design and development, and learning operations.

 Leadership and Behavioral Development 

 Support the design and delivery of leadership development programs for technical and people leaders within the Data Engineering function.

 Embed skills such as communication, stakeholder management, execution excellence, and people leadership.

 Learning Governance and Effectiveness 

 Define success metrics to measure learning effectiveness and business impact.

 Review learning outcomes through feedback from managers, mentors, and participants.

 Continuously refine programs based on data, feedback, and evolving business needs.

 Leverage Learning Management Systems (LMS) to track learning progress, adoption, and effectiveness, with a working understanding of LMS capabilities and governance.

 Stakeholder and Program Management 

 Manage multiple learning initiatives simultaneously while ensuring quality, timelines, and alignment.

 Collaborate closely with HR, Talent, and leadership teams to drive cohesive development outcomes.

 Required Experience & Skills 

 Experience 

 10–13 years of experience in Learning & Development, with prior experience supporting Data Engineering or similar technical businesses.

 Understanding of Data Engineering roles, skills, and career progression.

 Proven experience in business partnering and influencing senior stakeholders.

 Experience designing structured learning journeys covering both technical and leadership development.

 Ability to translate complex technical needs into effective learning solutions.

 Skills 

 Strong communication, stakeholder management, and execution skills.

 Strong reporting and analytics capability, with advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint to generate clear, insightful monthly learning reports and dashboards.

 Note: 

 By submitting your application, you consent to being contacted by our Talent Acquisition team via phone call, email, SMS, WhatsApp, or other communication channels regarding your application and relevant career opportunities.

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Data Platform Engineering
jobs.description:
About SimpliSafe 

 We’re a high-tech home security company that’s passionate about protecting the life you’ve built and our mission of keeping Every Home Secure. And we’ve created a culture here that cares just as deeply about the career you’re building. Ours is a no ego culture of collaboration and innovation where those seeking their next challenge can find big opportunities and make a huge impact on the lives of all those who we protect. We don’t just want you to work here. We want you to grow and thrive here. 

We’re embracing a hybrid work model that enables our teams to split their time between office and home. Hybrid for us means we expect our teams to come together in our state-of-the-art office on two core days, typically Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday – working together in person and choosing where they work for the remainder of the week. We all benefit from flexibility and get to use the best of both worlds to get our work done.

 Why are we hiring? 

 Well, we’re growing and thriving. So, we need smart, talented, and humble people who share our values to join us as we disrupt the home security space and relentlessly pursue our mission of keeping Every Home Secure.

 About the Job 

 SimpliSafe has quickly emerged as a leader in the home security space, thanks to our commitment to innovation and customer-centric solutions. We’re seeking individuals to join our growing team to help carry out our mission to make every customer feel safe and secure in their home.

 We’re investing in a multi-quarter Enterprise Data Platform program to move our data and analytics stack onto a modern lakehouse. We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Data Platform Engineering to lead the team that builds, operates, and evolves that platform, and to make sure SimpliSafe owns and can run what we build. You’ll manage the current platform, partner with vendors to implement the new one, and work with the Senior Manager, Data Engineering to plan the deprecation of legacy infrastructure. You’ll stay close enough to the technical work to review designs, challenge estimates, and make the calls that matter, without being your team’s sole architect.

 Who You’ll Work With 

 You’ll report to the Senior Director, Data Platform, and lead a team of core platform and data integration engineers plus a Data Architect. You’ll work closely with the Senior Manager, Data Engineering, whose team builds and operates the silver and gold pipelines that serve our Analytics and Data Science organizations. Your platform is the foundation they build on. You’ll also partner with the Senior Program Manager, who owns the integrated roadmap and executive reporting, and with Security, Privacy, and Infrastructure, who retain enterprise policy and risk accountability.

 What You’ll Do 

 Lead and grow the team. Hire, coach, develop, and performance-manage platform, DevOps, and integration engineers plus the Data Architect, and manage capacity across build, migration, and legacy support.

 Own the platform roadmap. Translate target architecture into sequenced capabilities, engineering standards, and team plans, balancing new capability against reliability, cost, and technical debt.

 Own the core platform: environments, deployment patterns, orchestration, CI/CD, and infrastructure automation, delivered as self-service patterns and templates rather than a ticket queue.

 Own ingestion and integration. Build reusable frameworks across batch, replication, CDC, and API, plus standards for source onboarding, schema change, data contracts, metadata, and lineage.

 Own reliability and observability: incident response, recovery, on-call practices, monitoring, and alerting, extending coverage across data products with the Senior Manager, Data Engineering.

 Own platform cost and performance. Drive compute and workload optimization and cost visibility, in partnership with Finance and Infrastructure.

 Set architecture direction with the Data Architect on major decisions, standards, and exceptions without becoming an approval gate, and build security, privacy, access, and governance requirements into how the platform runs.

 Own technical acceptance of implementation-partner work. Define acceptance criteria, review mechanisms, and knowledge transfer so our engineers can operate the platform before handoff.

 Lead platform and ingestion migration off the legacy estate, supporting Data Engineering’s workload and data-product cutover.

 Minimum Qualifications 

 8+ years in data platform, data engineering, or infrastructure engineering , including 5+ years managing engineering teams , with a track record of hiring senior and staff engineers and growing technical leadership beneath you.

 Built and operated a modern cloud lakehouse in production (Databricks or comparable), including the environment, CI/CD, and access model, not only the workloads running on it.

 Ran a platform migration while the legacy environment stayed in production: parallel operation, reconciliation, cutover, and decommissioning.

 Led external delivery partners or vendor engineering teams. Defined technical acceptance criteria, held partners to them, and brought the capability in-house rather than leaving a dependency.

 Built ingestion at scale (batch, replication, CDC, and API) on a reusable framework, with production pipeline reliability as your responsibility.

 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

 Preferred Qualifications 

 Databricks depth: Unity Catalog, Workflows/Jobs, Delta/DLT.

 AWS data stacks (S3, Iceberg/Delta) and streaming (Kafka).

 Owned platform cost and performance: accountable for a consumption or budget line, with specific optimizations you can point to.

 Retired or replaced in-house platform component in favor of a supported alternative.

 Consumer products, hardware, technology, or subscription businesses. 

 What Values You’ll Share 

 Customer Obsessed - Building deep empathy for our customers, putting them at the core of our work, and developing strong, long-term relationships with them.

 Aim High - Always challenging ourselves and others to raise the bar.

 No Ego - Maintaining a “no job too small” attitude, and an open, inclusive and humble style.

 One Team - Taking a highly collaborative approach to achieving success.

 Lift As We Climb - Investing in developing others and helping others around us succeed.

 Lean & Nimble - Working with agility and efficiency to experiment in an often ambiguous environment.

 What We Offer 

 A mission- and values-driven culture and a safe, inclusive environment where you can build, grow and thrive 

 A comprehensive total rewards package that supports your wellness and provides security for SimpliSafers and their families (For more information on our total rewards please click here ) 

 Free SimpliSafe system and professional monitoring for your home. 

 Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that bring people together, give opportunities to network, mentor and develop, and advocate for change.

 The target annual base pay range for this role is $171,200 - $228,200.

 This target annual base pay range represents our good-faith estimate of what we expect to pay for this role. We use a market-based compensation approach to set our target annual base pay ranges and make adjustments annually. We carefully tailor individual compensation packages, including base pay, taking into consideration employees’ job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and other relevant business factors. 

 Beyond base pay, we offer a Total Rewards package that may include participation in our annual bonus program, equity, and other forms of compensation, in addition to a full range of medical, retirement, and lifestyle benefits. More details can be found here .

 We’re committed to fair and equitable pay practices, as well as pay transparency. We regularly review our programs to ensure they remain competitive and aligned with our values.

 We wholeheartedly embrace and actively seek applications from all individuals, no matter how they identify. We are committed to cultivating a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we believe our work is enriched when we incorporate a multitude of perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences. We want everyone who works here to thrive and contribute to not only our mission of keeping every home secure, but also to making our workplace safe and supportive for others. If a reasonable accommodation may be needed to fully participate in the job application or interview process, to perform the essential functions of a position, or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact careers@simplisafe.com .

jobs.title: Distinguished Engineer - Data Architect
jobs.description:
For more than 30 years, SonicWall has delivered a partner-first unified cybersecurity portfolio that helps SMBs, MSPs, and IT teams consolidate network security, endpoint security, security service edge (SSE), and threat response across hybrid environments. By bringing connected technology, real-time threat intelligence, automation, and expert services together, SonicWall helps organizations simplify security operations, achieve better security outcomes, and lower total cost of ownership. Backed by a global ecosystem of more than 17,000 partners, SonicWall delivers enterprise-grade protection built for SMB and mid-market realities. 

 For more information, visit www.sonicwall.com or follow us on X, LinkedIn , Facebook , and Instagram . 

 Job Title: Distinguished Engineer - Data Architect 

 Role Overview: 

 We are looking for a Distinguished Engineer- Data Architect to design and build the data foundation for our AI-driven security platform. In this role, you will own the architectural blueprint and core implementation of our data strategy, transforming massive streams of high-velocity network traffic logs, customer configurations, and security alerts into high-performance, ML-ready data fabrics.

 As part of a lean, elite three-person Data & AI team, you will serve as the ultimate technical authority on data scale, streaming architecture, multi-tenant security, and cost-efficient storage systems.

 Key Responsibilities: 

 Architect the Core Data Platform: Design, implement, and evolve a unified blueprint for streaming and batch data processing capable of ingesting, normalizing, and storing petabyte-scale, high-velocity security telemetry.

 Enable AI & Advanced Analytics: Partner directly with the Lead AI Engineer to architect the underlying storage, retrieval systems, and feature stores—including optimal vector database structures and data lakehouse layers—required for low-latency AI inference and training.

 Enforce Zero-Trust Data Governance: Architect strict multi-tenant isolation, data privacy guardrails, and compliance controls directly into the data fabric to protect sensitive customer network configurations and logs.

 Optimize Economics & Performance: Drive infrastructure cost-efficiency and performance tuning across data processing engines, storage layers, and cloud infrastructure, balancing ultra-low latency requirements with predictable cost scaling.

 Lead by Example: Write clean, foundational, high-performance code for critical infrastructure components, setting the standard for engineering excellence within the team.

 Required Experience & Skills: 

 Experience: 12+ years of data engineering and architecture experience, with a proven track record of designing production systems handling massive, high-throughput streaming datasets (e.g., networking logs, telemetry, or real-time event streams). 

 Distributed Systems Expertise: Deep, authoritative knowledge of distributed processing and streaming engines (e.g., Apache Flink, Spark, Kafka, Pulsar) and modern lakehouse architectures (e.g., Iceberg, Delta Lake).

 Hybrid Storage Architecture: Mastery of polyglot persistence, spanning traditional relational databases, NoSQL, Columnar engines (e.g., ClickHouse, DuckDB), and Vector databases (e.g., Milvus, Qdrant, Pinecone).

 Security & Infrastructure: Strong fundamentals in secure data architectures, network topography, encryption-at-rest/in-transit, containerization (Kubernetes), and cloud-native infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure).

 Mindset: A rare combination of visionary architecture and hands-on execution. You thrive in ultra-lean teams, enjoy writing core code, and possess the pragmatism to build for immediate needs while planning for massive scale.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
About StarRez 

StarRez is the global leader in student housing software, providing innovative solutions for on and off-campus housing management, resident wellness and experience, and revenue generation. Trusted by 1,400+ clients across 25+ countries, StarRez supports more than 4 million beds annually with its user-friendly, all-in-one platform, delivering seamless experiences for students and administrators. With offices in the United States, Australia, the UK, and India, StarRez blends the robust capabilities of a global organization with the personalized care and service of a trusted partner.

 The Role 

 You have an uncanny knack for problem solving and you have a sharp product mindset. Our engineers are involved in all aspects of the software design process and create high-performing, scalable, and secure products. You’ll work alongside cross-functional teams to design right-size solutions that power a new market-leading Analytics platform. 

 As a Data Engineer at StarRez, you will play a critical role in building and scaling the foundations of our Analytics & Data Platform. You’ll design and maintain reliable, secure, and scalable data pipelines and models that power a new generation of reporting, insights, and data-driven products across the StarRez ecosystem. 

 This role sits at the intersection of data, product, and engineering. You will work closely with Data Analysts, Full-Stack Engineers, and Product teams to translate customer and business requirements into robust data solutions - enabling everything from standardised dashboards to advanced analytics and embedded intelligence. 

 You are hands-on, pragmatic, and comfortable working in a fast-evolving environment where you’ll help shape both the technical platform and the operating model as we scale. 

 What you’ll be doing 

 Build and maintain scalable data pipelines to ingest, transform, and model data for analytics and reporting 

 Develop and optimise data models to support consistent dashboards and KPI definitions 

 Ensure data quality and reliability through testing, monitoring, and observability practices 

 Work with Data Analysts and Product teams to translate requirements into reusable datasets and pipelines 

 Collaborate with Engineering to support data integration, schema automation, and platform scalability 

 Integrate data from internal and external sources (APIs, third-party systems) 

 Improve performance, scalability, and cost efficiency of the data platform 

 Contribute to embedding analytics into the product (dashboards, reporting, data services) 

 Support advanced use cases such as forecasting, benchmarking, and data-driven insights 

 Required Qualifications 

 3+ years of hands-on experience as a Data Engineer, building and maintaining reliable, scalable data pipelines and platforms 

 Experience designing and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines (batch and/or streaming) 

 Experience with cloud data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Azure Synapse, Microsoft Fabric or similar) including IAC 

 Familiarity with modern data tooling (e.g., dbt, Airflow, Fivetran, Azure Data Factory or equivalents) 

 Understanding of data integration patterns (APIs, ingestion pipelines, transformation layers) and Solid understanding of data modelling (star schema, dimensional modelling, data warehousing concepts)  

 Knowledge of data quality, testing, and observability practices (monitoring, validation, lineage)  

 Strong database fundamentals and SQL experience; comfortable designing safe schema changes considering performance optimisation, scalability, and cost management in data systems 

 Ability to work closely with Data Analysts and stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable data solutions 

 Strong communication skills with the ability to turn ambiguous requirements into structured data models and pipelines 

 Pragmatic approach to balancing speed, quality, and scalability 

 An inclination towards communication, inclusion, and visibility 

 Preferred Qualifications 

 Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps principles 

 Experience working with multi-tenant SaaS data models and secure data access patterns (e.g., tenant isolation, RBAC) 

 Proficiency with one or more public cloud providers such as Azure, AWS or GCP 

 Experience building foundations for modern analytics/data platforms and cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, Azure Synapse, Microsoft Fabric) 

 Experience with data pipeline tooling and patterns (e.g., Azure Data Factory, Snowflake Openflow, Fivetran, dbt, or similar tools) 

 Familiarity with multi-tenant SaaS analytics patterns (tenant isolation, RBAC, auditability, and data access controls such as row-level security where applicable) 

 Strong operational mindset: observability/monitoring, runbooks, incident response, and production support readiness for GA launches 

 Even if you don't have all of the Preferred Qualifications listed above, but feel you have what it takes to succeed in the role, we would love to hear from you!  

 Reasons to join our Team: 

 StarRez is not just a workplace—it’s a place to belong, build, and grow.     

 A Culture That Lasts: Many of our team members have been with us for 20+ years—a testament to our people-first philosophy.     

 Global Impact, Local Ownership : Join a team that spans across Australia, the USA, the UK, and Canada, working on industry-leading solutions, while building the centre up from ground up.     

 Long-Term Vision: We’re not here for short-term gains. We invest in our people for the long haul, creating an environment where you can grow, lead, and thrive.     

 Innovation with Stability : Backed by Vista Equity Partners, we combine the agility of a scaling SaaS company with the stability of long-term industry leadership.     

 Z-Factor: We take pride in our culture of passion, care, and high performance. The Z-Factor defines how we support our teams, foster growth, and ensure that everyone at StarRez thrives.     

 If you are excited about building game-changing products in a high-impact, collaborative environment—StarRez India is the place for you.     

 We are proud of our diverse workforce and are dedicated to creating a safe and welcoming environment for all employees. People from various ethnicities, ages, genders, and abilities are encouraged to apply.   

 Notice to external Recruiters and Recruitment Agencies:   

 StarRez will not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies, headhunters, or any other third parties for this role through this website or directly to any employee. StarRez and any of our subsidiaries will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company. In addition, we ask that you do not reach out to any employee with regards to this position, or any other positions, now, or in the future. 

 StarRez is an equal opportunity employer.

 StarRez is an equal opportunity employer.

At StarTree we're a group of passionate individuals that desire to improve the lives of many by developing tools and technologies that support availability and speed in the world of real-time analytics. 

 Our aim is to make it simple for every company to delight their users - external and internal - and create new revenue streams from their data, by building the world’s most comprehensive and accessible cloud analytics system. 

 Team and Responsibilities 

 Apache Pinot is a distributed analytics database built for real-time applications at massive scale . It powers mission-critical workloads at companies including Splunk, Meesho, CrowdStrike, Together AI, and Charter Telecom , where milliseconds matter and scale is measured in millions of events and tens of thousands of queries per second.

 CrowdStrike processes up to 120K events/sec and serves 25K queries/sec ; Together AI analyzes billions of LLM token events per hour with sub-second latency; and Charter Telecom operates Pinot at an ingestion scale of 120M events/sec . These aren't just benchmarks—they are production systems powering real customer experiences.

 At StarTree, you’ll work on the distributed systems behind this scale—solving hard problems in performance, reliability, concurrency, and data infrastructure. You’ll have the opportunity to make an impact from day one, take ownership of meaningful problems, and grow rapidly in a high-ownership startup environment.

 You Will 

 Own and drive impactful distributed systems problems end-to-end, from inception through production launch.

 Collaborate with a strong engineering team to identify and prioritize the most impactful problems and projects for the company.

 Raise the quality bar across engineering while helping keep our systems reliable and operationally lean.

 Mentor and grow engineers while learning from experienced, battle-tested engineers around you.

 Skills & Experience 

 Strong distributed systems fundamentals and experience solving problems at scale. Our platform is Java-based, so Java experience is a plus, but not a hard requirement.

 Bias toward execution — able to take an idea from concept through implementation and deliver it to production.

 Deep ownership of quality and customer experience , with a strong focus on reliability, observability, performance, and ease of use.

 Adaptability and flexibility — willing to take on whatever is most important for the company and adjust to changing priorities.

 Curiosity, positivity, and resilience — comfortable navigating ambiguity and uncertainty while maintaining a constructive, problem-solving mindset.

 AI-First Mindset - Comfortable using AI tools in everyday engineering workflows and eager to continuously learn and integrate AI into how you build, debug, test, and solve problems. 

 About StarTree: 

 StarTree is a cloud-based software company that enables business customers to derive advanced insights from real-time and historical data. StarTree was founded by the core software engineering team and inventors of Apache Pinot , which currently powers hundreds of user-facing applications at companies across industries, including LinkedIn, Uber, Target, 7Eleven, Etsy, Walmart, WePay, Factual, Weibo, and more. StarTree Cloud has enabled even more companies to deploy and operate real-time analytics at scale, including Stripe, Sovrn, Roadie, Just Eat Takeaway.com, Dialpad, Guitar Center, Blinkit, and more.

 StarTree is backed by leading investors including GGV Capital, Sapphire Ventures, Bain Capital Ventures, CRV, and Citi”

 KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.

 POSITION OVERVIEW 

 The Insurance Data Science team reports through the Chief Risk Officer and uses AI and machine learning techniques to develop predictive models for policy-level transactions and human behavior. The models are used to develop and price retail products and institutional reinsurance deals, monitor related risk, and assist in forecasting and financial reporting. The group has a unique vantage point in nearly all aspects of the enterprise and is actively enhancing its capacity, continuing to grow with the whole company. The successful candidate will have an opportunity to work on a variety of projects depending on skill set, interest, and personal goals, and to collaborate with other teams with functions mentioned above.

 The team is heavily invested in developing agentic AI tools to solve company-wide problems and boost efficiency of all aspects of work.

 RESPONSIBILITIES 

 Owning AI-assisted data reconciliation system and ETL

 Manage complicated data projects partnered enterprise data engineering team

 Use AI tools to develop new data pipelines and validation tools

 Build AI-native applications to solve data problems

 Perform ad hoc data analysis

 Potentially building advanced machine learning models leverage big data and high-performance computing tools

 QUALIFICATIONS 

 Bachelor's or master's degree in top universities with concentrations in computer science, data science, statistics, or any other related quantitative fields

 3-5 years of industry work experience as data engineer or data scientist

 Strong programming skills in Python and SQL with or without AI tools

 Strong knowledge in database design and operation, data structure

 Proficient in developing and maintaining software and data infrastructure using Claude Code or any other substitutes

 Extraordinary analytical, organizational, and communication (written and verbal) skills are required

 Pro-active, detail oriented, and deadline driven

 Tracking record of building and deploying agentic AI application into production is plus

 Knowledge in high performance computing and big-data tools are plus

 Insurance industry work experience, especially with annuities is plus

 POSITION SUMMARY 
We are seeking a Principal Data Lead to set the technical direction of our Reference Data Platform — the system of record that masters, governs, and distributes the firm’s core reference data (parties, instruments, portfolios, and accounts. This is a hands-on technical leadership role: you will own the end-to-end architecture of a layered, event-driven data platform — spanning sourcing, ingestion, entity mastering, a bitemporal golden copy, and an API-first distribution layer — and drive it from vision to production. You will be the senior-most engineering voice on reference data, shaping platform strategy, establishing engineering standards across teams, and partnering with product, data, and infrastructure leaders to deliver a scalable, vendor-agnostic master data capability. The ideal candidate is an expert Python engineer and data architect with deep experience in master data management (MDM) and reference data within the financial industry — including market data and vendor feeds — combined with hands-on experience applying Generative AI to data platforms, distributed data processing, and building reusable, independently scalable platform components.

 We are operating in a 4-day in office, 1-day flexible work arrangement. 

 ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES 
• Own the architecture of a layered reference-data platform, defining the contracts between sourcing, ingestion, mastering, golden-copy, and distribution layers so each is independently buildable, deployable, and scalable.
• Set technical direction for entity mastering — standardization, blocking, matching, survivorship, and crosswalk/lineage — designing rules as configuration (data, not code) that scale from exact-match fast paths to full-population fuzzy resolution.
• Architect the durable golden copy: a bitemporal, point-in-time source of truth with match evidence, per-attribute provenance, and a schema-last serving model that adapts to new sources and domains without migration.
• Define the event-driven backbone and cadence model (start-of-day, intraday, end-of-day, and on-demand) enabling batch today and real-time streaming (CDC / Kafka) without re-architecture.
• Design the API-first, self-documenting distribution surface (REST, curated data products, subscriptions) governed by data contracts and consumable by applications, analytics, and AI/agents.
• Drive the platform’s storage and compute strategy over an open lakehouse (Apache Iceberg, Snowflake) and elastic compute (Spark), ensuring an open, vendor-agnostic, no-lock-in foundation.
• Establish engineering standards, reference patterns, and a reusable component library (a layered monorepo) that make capabilities build-once, reuse-everywhere across domains.
• Lead cross-team technical design reviews, resolve the hardest architectural trade-offs, and align engineering execution with the firm’s data strategy.
• Champion data quality, governance, security, entitlements, audit, and observability as first-class, cross-cutting foundations of the platform.
• Mentor senior and staff engineers, grow technical depth across the team, and set the bar for engineering excellence.
• Partner with product and business stakeholders to translate reference-data needs into a durable, scalable platform roadmap.

 QUALIFICATIONS 

 • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
• 12+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant time as a technical lead or architect of data-intensive platforms.
• Expert-level proficiency in Python for building production services, data pipelines, and platform frameworks.
• Proven experience architecting master data management (MDM) or reference/entity-data systems — entity resolution, survivorship, golden records, crosswalk, and lineage.
• Deep data engineering expertise: data modeling, ETL/ELT design, distributed processing (Spark), and data distribution patterns at scale.
• Hands-on experience designing API-first services and event-driven / streaming architectures (e.g., Kafka, CDC).
• Strong command of modern data storage — relational, non-relational, and lakehouse formats (e.g., Apache Iceberg) — and SQL.
• Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and cloud-native deployment (containers, Kubernetes/EKS, CI/CD).
• Deep domain experience with reference and master data in the financial industry — parties / legal entities, instruments, portfolios, and accounts — and the identifier, hierarchy, and cross-referencing challenges specific to it.
• Hands-on experience integrating and mastering market data and vendor/administrator feeds (e.g., Bloomberg, exchange, and fund-servicing sources), including normalization, cross-referencing, and point-in-time handling.
• Practical experience applying Generative AI / LLMs to data platforms — e.g., grounded retrieval over governed data, entity-resolution and data-quality assistance, or AI/agent-ready data access with provenance guarantees.
• A track record of setting technical direction, driving architecture across teams, and mentoring senior engineers.
• Excellent judgment on architectural trade-offs, and the communication skills to align engineering, product, and business stakeholders.

 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience with workflow orchestration (e.g., Dagster, Airflow) and lakehouse catalogs (e.g., Polaris, Nessie, Glue).

jobs.description:
About Us 

 Tamara is a leading fintech platform in Saudi Arabia and the GCC region with a mission to help people own their dreams built on being simple, trusted, and everywhere our customers need us. Today, more than 25 million customers and over 130,000 partner merchants depend on Tamara every day for reliable financial solutions across retail, travel, education, healthcare, and beyond. Tamara is backed by Sanabil Investments, a wholly owned company of the Public Investment Fund (PIF), and SNB Capital, among others.

 Your Role

 We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join the team building Tamara's next-generation data core - a multi-cloud data platform spanning Event Streaming, Data Warehousing, and Experimentation. You will be hands-on; designing and operating petabyte-scale streaming and batch systems that run across clouds. This role is ideal for engineers who love solving complex data challenges at scale, think with a platform mindset, and are excited to raise the technical bar of the team around them.

 Your Responsibilities

 Lead the design and build of platform components that run across multiple clouds — addressing portability, cross-cloud replication, HA/DR, and data residency requirements of a regulated fintech environment, and designing against single-cloud lock-in.

 Build and operate large-scale event streaming infrastructure on Kafka, including configuration tuning and cross-cluster replication between cloud environments.

 Build and maintain real-time and batch data pipelines using tools like Kafka, Spark, and Airflow.

 Drive the development of a scalable LakeHouse architecture using modern open table formats such as Iceberg or Delta Lake.

 Own reliable, cost-aware operation of multi-cloud data infrastructure — SLO-based observability, data quality, and lineage.

 Enable Analytics and Product teams through self-serve data products, well-modeled warehouse foundations and marts, and reusable ingestion (inbound) and consumption (outbound) patterns.

 Provide technical leadership to a group of 5-6 engineers and data engineers — leading design reviews, setting engineering standards, and driving knowledge sharing and documentation.

 Your Expertise

 Our stack today: GCP · BigQuery · Kafka/Redpanda · Debezium · dbt · Spark · Airflow · Terraform · Kubernetes

 Preferably 6+ years of experience in data engineering or distributed backend systems, including 3**+ years operating large-scale streaming or data platform infrastructure in production**, and experience mentoring or technically leading engineers.

 Hands-on experience with streaming platforms (e.g., Kafka) and distributed processing tools (e.g., Spark or Flink) — our event streaming platform is built on Kafka.

 Hands-on experience building and operating data pipelines on GCP with BigQuery (and familiarity with multi-cloud patterns).

 Working knowledge of LakeHouse formats (Iceberg/Delta/Hudi) and columnar storage like Parquet.

 Experience with infrastructure-as-code and cloud-agnostic tooling (e.g., Terraform, Kubernetes) for deploying and operating data platforms across clouds.

 Strong in data modeling and optimizing cloud data warehouses — we run on BigQuery and looking to expand to other Cloud DWHs.

 Who You Are

 A mentor and multiplier: passionate about driving engineering best practices and guiding a group of engineers to grow and deliver.

 An owner: you build it, you run it — comfortable carrying operational responsibility for mission-critical streaming and data systems.

 Comfortable with evolving scope and ambiguity as the platform grows from one cloud to many.

 Compliance-aware: you treat security, data residency, and auditability as first-class design constraints in fintech.

 Motivated by aligning data architecture with business outcomes, and by building platforms other teams love to use.

 Nice to Have

 Familiarity with observability tools like Prometheus, Grafana, and Loki to monitor and troubleshoot data systems.

 Exposure to real-time OLAP engines like ClickHouse, Apache Druid, or Apache Pinot for low-latency analytics.

 Prior experience in fintech or a highly regulated industry, with awareness of data residency, security, and compliance requirements.

 Experience in Airflow or similar orchestration platforms.

jobs.description:
Lead data engineers at Thoughtworks develop modern data architecture approaches to meet key business objectives and provide end-to-end data solutions. They might spend a few weeks with a new client on a deep technical review or a complete organizational review, helping them to understand the potential that data brings to solve their most pressing problems. Alongside hands-on coding, they are leading the team to implement the solution.

 Director of Engineering – Data Platform

 Vectra AI is transforming cybersecurity through AI-driven threat detection and response.Our platform ingests and analyzes petabytes of customer telemetry, including network packets, logs, identity signals, and security events, to surface real-time insights, advanced detections, and autonomous security outcomes. The Data Platform organization sits at the heart of that mission, powering analytics, detections, machine learning, and next-generation AI capabilities. 

 The Opportunity 

 We're looking for a Director of Engineering to lead the teams that form the foundation of everything Vectra builds. You'll own the systems that ingest, process, store, and analyze petabytes of security telemetry daily, and you'll drive the platform forward to support modern AI workloads, autonomous security workflows, and next-generation analytics.

You'll need to be architecturally fluent, able to engage deeply on system design, challenge assumptions, and identify risks before they become problems. You'll work closely with our platform architects on technical direction, but you're expected to bring your own point of view and push back when something doesn't hold up. 

 What You'll Do

 Build, grow, and mentor high-performing engineering teams across multiple geographies. 

 Develop engineering managers and senior technical leaders through coaching, sponsorship, and career investment. 

 Foster an inclusive culture built on trust, ownership, and accountability, where distributed teams can do their best work. 

 Create the conditions for strong execution: clear priorities, healthy team rhythms, and an environment where engineers can focus on meaningful work.

 Communicate platform strategy, progress, risks, and trade-offs clearly to executive leadership. 

 Partner with customer-facing teams to understand evolving data requirements and scaling challenges. 

 Influence company-wide direction around data, AI, and platform capabilities. 

 Execution and Operational Excellence 

 Lead delivery of large-scale platform initiatives, balancing innovation, reliability, and speed. 

 Set engineering best practices across data processing, schema evolution, data quality, and service-level objectives. 

 Own production operations, incident management, and continuous improvement. 

 Ensure predictable delivery while keeping a clear line of sight to customer impact and long-term platform health. 

 Technical Strategy and Platform Direction 

 Engage deeply on architecture decisions for scalable, reliable, and AI-ready infrastructure, able to ask hard questions, identify gaps, and pressure-test designs alongside platform architects. 

 Champion a platform-first mindset with self-service APIs, strong developer tooling, observability, and documentation that accelerate Data Science, AI/ML, and product teams. 

 Drive adoption of modern platform capabilities including feature stores, vector storage, and model serving infrastructure. 

 Champion the use of AI to improve engineering productivity, software delivery, and incident response. 

 What You'll Bring 

 Required 

 10+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading engineering organizations. 

 Proven track record building and operating large-scale data platforms in production. 

 Deep expertise across large-scale data infrastructure: distributed systems, data ingestion pipelines, stream and batch processing, and storage systems at scale including object stores, columnar databases, and time-series systems.

 Experience with Databricks, including Spark-based processing and the Databricks platform ecosystem. 

 Experience running ML or AI workloads in production, including platforms, feature stores, or inference infrastructure. 

 Operational mindset: SRE principles, incident response, and a culture of reliability. 

 Experience building or operating platforms that support LLM-based applications, including retrieval, embeddings, and model serving.

 Track record optimizing cloud costs and performance at scale on AWS, Azure, or GCP. 

 Background in real-time detection systems or streaming analytics

 Reduced time from telemetry ingestion to model experimentation and deployment.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Network Protocols & Data Plane
jobs.description:
Vectra® is the leader in AI-driven threat detection and response for hybrid and multi-cloud enterprises.

 The Vectra AI Platform delivers integrated signal across public cloud, SaaS, identity, and data center networks in a single platform. Powered by patented Attack Signal Intelligence, it empowers security teams to rapidly prioritize, investigate and respond to the most advanced cyber-attacks. With 35 patents in AI-driven threat detection and the most vendor references in MITRE D3FEND, organizations worldwide rely on the Vectra AI to move at the speed and scale of hybrid attackers. For more information, visit www.vectra.ai. 

 Position Overview 

 Vectra is looking for senior, AI-forward engineers to help expand and modernize our network data plane. This team builds the high-performance systems that ingest, process, parse, enrich, and deliver network metadata used by our detection, investigation, and response platform.

 This role sits at the center of Vectra's packet-processing architecture. You will work on the systems that receive network traffic, steer it through the right processing paths, extract meaningful protocol metadata, and deliver that data reliably through the platform at production scale. Protocol parsing is a major part of the mission, but the broader opportunity is to help shape a scalable data plane that can support more protocols, higher throughput, better validation, and faster delivery over time.

 The work requires systems engineering depth, hands-on networking experience, and comfort operating close to Linux, packet capture, hardware constraints, and performance limits. We are looking for engineers who can operate independently, use modern AI-assisted development tools effectively, and help build a repeatable engine for delivering data-plane capabilities with strong validation, test coverage, performance discipline, and operational reliability.

 Responsibilities 

 Design, implement, test, and maintain core network data-plane capabilities, including packet processing, protocol parsing, metadata extraction, and downstream delivery.

 Improve scalable network data-path architecture on Linux, including packet ingestion, traffic steering, parser execution, metadata modeling, and downstream delivery.

 Use AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully to accelerate investigation, implementation, test generation, and code review while maintaining engineering rigor.

 Work across parsing, serialization, metadata modeling, validation, performance, and downstream platform integration.

 Build feedback loops and test harnesses that validate data-plane behavior end-to-end, not just in isolated parser tests.

 Diagnose correctness, performance, memory, concurrency, and reliability issues in complex packet-processing systems.

 Collaborate with Product, Security Research, Data Science, and engineering teams to turn customer and platform needs into concrete technical outcomes.

 Contribute to technical direction, design reviews, and engineering standards for network data-plane development.

 Requirements 

 8+ years of professional software engineering experience .

 5+ years of production C++ experience in systems, infrastructure, networking, or similarly performance-sensitive environments.

 Meaningful Rust experience or demonstrated ability to build production-quality systems in Rust or another memory-safe systems language.

 Strong Python coding, debugging, automation, and code review experience.

 Experience developing and debugging software on Debian-based Linux or similar Linux environments.

 Hands-on protocol experience, including inspecting packet captures, using Wireshark or equivalent tools, and implementing or debugging parsing and serialization logic.

 Experience with substantial data-path technologies such as DPDK, XDP/AF_XDP, kernel-bypass networking, high-performance packet capture, or equivalent systems.

 Understanding of NIC queues, RSS, tunneling, offloads, routing, traffic steering, and the practical constraints of packet-processing hardware.

 Systems programming depth across Linux networking internals, allocators and memory ownership, data structures, concurrency, CPU/cache behavior, and performance diagnosis.

 Experience building reliable, maintainable systems where correctness, throughput, latency, and operational reliability all matter.

 Ability to troubleshoot complex systems using measurement, logs, traces, packet captures, profiling, and careful reasoning.

 Ownership mindset: able to take a problem, clarify ambiguity, make tradeoffs visible, and drive it to completion.

 Strong communication and collaboration skills across distributed teams.

 Preferred 

 Experience building protocol parsers, packet-processing systems, network telemetry systems, or high-throughput data pipelines.

 Experience with parser validation, fuzzing, golden datasets, packet replay frameworks, or property-based testing.

 Familiarity with DPDK, Linux networking internals, eBPF, XDP/AF_XDP, Suricata, Zeek, or similar systems.

 Experience tuning systems across CPU, memory, NUMA, storage, and network boundaries.

 Experience designing schemas or metadata models consumed by downstream analytics, search, detection, or investigation workflows.

 Experience with CI/CD, Jenkins or similar systems, and Git-based development workflows.

 What We’re Looking For 

 The strongest candidates will be hands-on builders who are energized by hard systems problems. They should be comfortable moving fast, but not casually; quality, testability, maintainability, and performance all matter. We are especially interested in engineers who already use AI tools as part of their development workflow and can explain how they use them responsibly to improve speed, coverage, and understanding.

 Education 

 B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

 Vectra provides a comprehensive total rewards package that supports the financial, physical, mental and overall health of our employees and their families. Compensation includes competitive base pay, incentive pla n eligibility, and participation in the employee equity plan (stock options). Specific benefits offered var ies by location, but commonly in clude health care insurance , income protection / life insurance , access to retirement savings plans, behavioral & emotional wellness services , generous time away from work, and a comprehensive employee recognition program. 

 Vectra is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. 

 We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

 Familiarity with distributed systems, data architecture design, and big data technologies (e.g., Spark, Kafka, Lakehouse, Databricks)

jobs.title: Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Why Verifone 

 For more than 30 years, Verifone has established a remarkable record of leadership in the electronic payment technology industry. Verifone is one of the leading electronic payment solutions brands and among the largest providers of electronic payment systems worldwide.

Verifone has a diverse, dynamic, and fast-paced work environment in which employees are focused on results and have opportunities to excel. We take pride in working with leading retailers, merchants, banks, and third-party partners to invent and deliver innovative payment solutions around the world. We strive for excellence in our products and services and are obsessed with customer happiness.

Across the globe, Verifone employees are leading the payments industry through experience, innovation, and an ambitious spirit. Whether it’s developing the next generation of secure payment systems or finding new ways to bring electronic payments to emerging markets, the Verifone team is dedicated to the success of our customers, partners, and investors. It is this passion for innovation that drives every Verifone employee toward personal and professional success.

 Verifone is proudly an in-office work culture as we see immense benefits to career development and business results from our colleagues being physically co-located. 

 What’s Exciting About the Role 

 Verifone is looking for a Data Platform Engineer to join our Platform Engineering team. Rather than being a single-technology specialist position, this is a unique opportunity to your generalist skillset to own and evolve a broad data platform that spans streaming pipelines, multiple database technologies, on prem and cloud infrastructure, and DevOps/SRE operational tooling. 

 We are looking for experience in core technologies including Kafka, Redis, Data Lake technologies and Cloud Engineering, with the opportunity to leverage other skills such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, SQL Server and more. You will design and operate end-to-end data pipelines that power new AI and analytics initiatives, migrate streaming services to Kubernetes, and build the automation and tooling that reduces operational toil across the team. 

 If you are energized by working across the full data stack—pipelines, databases, infrastructure, observability, and CI/CD—rather than going deep on a single technology, this role is built for you. 

 Key Responsibilities 

 Data Platform & Pipeline Development 

 Design, build, and optimize end-to-end data pipelines—streaming and batch—that serve Verifone’s AI, machine learning, and analytics initiatives. 

 Work with diverse data technologies and formats: streaming via Kafka, batch via ETL processes, file formats such as Parquet, and table formats such as Iceberg or Delta Lake. 

 Collaborate with data engineering and development teams to enforce best practices for data flow, schema design, security, scalability, and performance. 

 Continuously improve data pipeline reliability, latency, and throughput across the full SDLC. 

 Support and integrate AWS data tooling including Athena, Glue, Redshift, and S3-based data lake patterns. 

 Streaming Infrastructure (Kafka & Ecosystem) 

 Manage and support Apache Kafka clusters (including AWS MSK), Kafka Connect, and KSQL for high-throughput, fault-tolerant event streaming. 

 Handle day-to-day Kafka operations: offset management, lag monitoring, consumer group management, cluster rebalancing, and partition tuning. 

 Perform cluster maintenance: upgrades, configuration changes, scaling events, and health checks. 

 Drive incident response and root cause analysis (RCA) for streaming platform issues. 

 Participate in the active effort to migrate Kafka and related services to Kubernetes. 

 Database Operations 

 Operate and support multiple database technologies in production: Redis, PostgreSQL and MySQL (indexing, replication, HA/DR, query tuning), and MongoDB. 

 Perform routine maintenance across database platforms: upgrades, configuration tuning, health monitoring, and capacity planning. 

 Support Snowflake data warehouse operations and integrations as part of the broader analytics stack. 

 Implement and uphold data security practices including encryption-in-transit/at-rest, secrets management, and least-privilege access across all data stores. 

 DevOps, SRE & Automation 

 Develop and maintain automation scripts (Python, Bash) to reduce manual toil and improve platform reliability. 

 Design, implement, and manage CI/CD pipelines for patching, deployment, and configuration automation. 

 Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, Ansible, or similar tools. 

 Containerize and orchestrate workloads using Docker and Kubernetes. 

 Manage cloud infrastructure on AWS: EC2, VPC, IAM, MSK, ElastiCache, CloudWatch, and related services. 

 Set up and maintain observability tooling—metrics, logs, and tracing—and participate in on-call incident response. 

 Support cloud migration tasks, moving workloads between on-prem and cloud environments. 

 Required Qualifications / Skills 

 We are looking for a well-rounded platform engineer with experience in Kafka, Redis, Data Lake technologies and Cloud Engineering. Candidates should demonstrate breadth across data, databases, DevOps and SRE skills: 

 5+ years of overall engineering experience, with demonstrated work across data pipelines, database operations, and infrastructure—not limited to a single technology. 

 Hands-on experience with Kafka or another distributed streaming platform (Kafka, Kinesis, Pulsar) in a production environment. 

 Operational experience with at least two of the following database technologies: Redis, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redshift or Snowflake. 

 Proven data pipeline experience: building or maintaining ETL/ELT processes, batch jobs, or streaming pipelines that serve analytics or operational use cases. 

 Strong scripting and automation skills (Python and/or Bash) with a track record of reducing manual toil. 

 CI/CD pipeline development and Infrastructure-as-Code experience (Terraform preferred). 

 Solid Linux fundamentals: networking basics, log analysis, system troubleshooting, process/memory/disk management. 

 Cloud engineering experience, preferably AWS (EC2, VPC, IAM, MSK/ElastiCache, CloudWatch). 

 Familiarity with observability practices—metrics, logs, tracing—and incident response workflows. 

 Understanding of distributed systems trade-offs: availability, consistency, partitions, backpressure. 

 Strong communication skills including the ability to present platform status and technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders. 

 Flexibility for on-call rotation and occasional weekend support. 

 Preferred Skills (Highly Desired) 

 Data Engineering Depth 

 Experience with stream processing frameworks: Kafka Streams, Apache Flink, or similar. 

 Familiarity with data lake table formats: Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Apache Hudi. 

 Hands-on experience with AWS data services: Athena, Glue, Redshift, or Lake Formation. 

 Working knowledge of Snowflake—data loading, query optimization, or integration patterns. 

 Understanding of data quality, data lineage, or schema registry concepts. 

 Infrastructure & Security 

 Container/Kubernetes depth: deployments, StatefulSets, storage classes, Helm. 

 On-prem infrastructure experience: VMware/KVM, SAN/NAS storage, network configuration. 

 Security and compliance experience, particularly PCI-DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard). 

 Secrets management tooling: HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, or similar. 

 What We Offer 

 Broad platform ownership—you will work across Kafka, Redis, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Snowflake, and more, growing as a well-rounded platform engineer rather than a single-tool specialist. 

 Direct impact on Verifone’s global payment infrastructure—your work keeps billions of transactions flowing reliably every year. 

 Ground-floor involvement in building the data pipelines that will drive Verifone’s AI, machine learning, and analytics strategy. 

 Hands-on participation in a Kafka-to-Kubernetes migration—a meaningful infrastructure modernization project from day one. 

 Mentorship from senior engineers and platform architects with deep production experience. 

 Clear career progression path from mid-level to senior and lead engineer. 

 Funded certification paths—Confluent (CCDAK, Certified Administrator), AWS (Solutions Architect, MSK Specialty), CKA, dbt—plus budget for courses and technical conferences. 

 Hybrid/remote working flexibility with a collaborative team culture. 

 Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives. 

 Our Commitment 

 Verifone is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Verifone is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status.

jobs.title: Data Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Who We Are 

 Verve has created a more efficient and privacy-focused way to buy and monetize advertising. Verve is an ecosystem of demand and supply technologies fusing data, media, and technology together to deliver results and growth to both advertisers and publishers–no matter the screen or location, no matter who, what, or where a customer is. With offices across the globe and with an eye on servicing forward-thinking advertising customers, Verve’s solutions are trusted by more than 90 of the United States’ top 100 advertisers, 4,000 publishers globally, and the world’s top demand-side platforms. Learn more at verve.com . 

 What You Will Do 

 Provide full supervision and support for the local data engineering pod, spanning both data-platform and analytics/reporting work streams.

 Manage team capacity, lead hiring to backfill and grow the pod, and define team charters that support a fast-evolving data platform roadmap.

 Foster a high-performance culture across a distributed organization (Bangalore and EU), onboarding recent hires and establishing strong operational discipline (on-call/IRM, runbooks, incident response).

 Plan and execute multi-quarter initiatives with many interdependencies (e.g., the data lakehouse re-architecture (Apache Flink on GKE), the dedicated CTV late-impression pipeline, and CI/CD automation (ArgoCD)) ensuring alignment with architectural standards.

 Refine the team's engineering processes, methodologies, and technical standards: code quality, infrastructure-as-code, deployment automation, observability, and cost optimization.

 Partner closely with Product Management, Backend Engineering, Data Science, and Analytics to align the platform roadmap with business objectives.

 Stay active in technical implementation (estimated 50-70% hands-on): designing pipelines, delivering new product features, reviewing architecture and code, addressing tech debts, and troubleshooting production data issues.

 Undertake production responsibilities including setting up monitoring and alerts, oncall support, troubleshooting, incident management and communication, and postmortem.

 Independently design maintainable and scalable data systems for complex, high-throughput streaming and batch pipelines. Be aware and manage the infrastructure cost of data systems.

 What You Will Bring 

 Minimum of 8 years of experience in Data Engineering, with a focus on leadership in technical settings.

 AdTech industry expertise (specifically programmatic auctions and high-volume bid/impression/RTB data) is strongly preferred.

 Expert knowledge of Python and SQL.

 Deep, hands-on experience with distributed data processing and streaming: Apache Spark / Spark Streaming and Apache Flink.

 Strong experience operating high-throughput event streaming and messaging with Apache Kafka.

 Proficiency with the Google Cloud data stack (BigQuery, GKE, GCS, Dataflow/Vertex AI) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform).

 Experience building and operating CI/CD for data pipelines (e.g., ArgoCD, containerized/Docker deployments).

 Working knowledge of lakehouse and open table formats (e.g., Iceberg/Delta) and the trade-offs between real-time and batch architectures (latency, cost, governance).

 Familiarity with analytics/OLAP and BI tooling (e.g., Druid, Looker, Rill/Turnilo) and dimensional data modeling.

 What We Offer

 Keep healthy through our Apollo Health Check-ups , and stay covered with our Medical Insurance for you and your family

 Pick what matters most to you in our INR 4100/month Personalized Benefits Platform: Travel, entertainment, food, fitness, and healthcare

 Have us cover your office lunches 3 times a week through Zomato , and enjoy office sweets, snacks, and beverages

 Boost your professional knowledge with our annual training budget & internal webinars , and level up your language skills through our German/English classes 

 Recharge with 19 paid vacation days + 3 Wellness days throughout the year, in addition to the public holidays

 Strengthen team connections while exploring new cultures through our monthly Work&Travel raffle, offering a chance to work from one of our global offices (after 2 years of employment)

 … and even more reasons to join us!

jobs.description:
About WPP Media 

 WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

 WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

 For more information, visit wppmedia.com .

 Note: for this role it is necessary to speak and write fluently Dutch. 

 Word jij enthousiast van het bouwen van schaalbare data-oplossingen op het snijvlak van marketing, analytics en data engineering? Vind je het leuk om technische uitdagingen op te lossen en marketingdata automatisch beschikbaar te maken voor analyses, dashboards en activatie? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

 Wat ga je doen als Analytics Engineer? 

 Als Analytics Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen, bouwen en beheren van data-oplossingen die marketing- en klantdata toegankelijk maken voor analyses, rapportages en activatie. Je werkt op het snijvlak van digital analytics, data engineering en marketing technology.

 Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt datamodellen, geautomatiseerde datastromen en integraties tussen verschillende platformen. Daarbij maak je gebruik van tools zoals DBT, Adverity, data warehouses, API-koppelingen en Customer Data Platforms (CDP's). Je zorgt ervoor dat data uit marketingplatformen, analytics-tools en andere databronnen op een betrouwbare en schaalbare manier beschikbaar komt voor klanten en collega's.

 Naast het technische werk denk je mee over de architectuur van data-oplossingen en adviseer je klanten over de mogelijkheden om hun marketing- en datastrategie verder te professionaliseren. Hierbij werk je intensief samen met andere Data & Tech specialisten.

 Wie ben jij? 

 Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar ervaring binnen analytics engineering, marketing technology of data engineering

 Je hebt ervaring met dbt en het modelleren van data binnen moderne data platformen

 Je hebt goede SQL-vaardigheden en ervaring met het bouwen van datamodellen

 Je hebt ervaring met API-integraties en geautomatiseerde datastromen

 Je hebt ervaring met marketing- en klantdataplatformen zoals CDP's, marketing automation platformen of vergelijkbare oplossingen

 Kennis van de Google Marketing Platform stack, GA4, BigQuery of vergelijkbare ecosystemen is een pré

 Je hebt ervaring met scripting in Python of een vergelijkbare programmeertaal

 Je begrijpt hoe marketingprocessen werken en vindt het leuk om deze verder te automatiseren

 Je bent in staat technische architecturen begrijpelijk uit te leggen aan niet-technische stakeholders

 Je bent zelfstandig, neemt initiatief en vindt het leuk om klanten te adviseren

 Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels

 Wat bieden wij?
 Bij WPP Media werk je in een ambitieus en creatief team aan een merk dat volop in ontwikkeling is. Je krijgt de ruimte om echt impact te maken op hoe we ons in de markt positioneren, hoe we proposities lanceren en hoe we thought leadership tot leven brengen. 

 Flexibiliteit: Mogelijkheid om thuis te werken, flexibele werktijden én zelfs voor een tijdje in het buitenland (EU).

 Groeikansen : Volop ruimte voor ontwikkeling in een innovatief en dynamisch team.

 Salaris: Een marktconform salaris (op basis van 38,75 uur per week).

 Toegang tot M Academy: Voor uitgebreide trainingen en workshops in zowel hard als soft skills, inclusief specifieke AI-trainingen.

 Mental Wellbeing : Toegang tot het platform Tellus

 Vakantie : 8% vakantiegeld en 26 vakantiedagen per jaar (plus 9 extra bij te kopen!).

 Hybrid Working allowance : €30 netto per maand bij fulltime.

 Bring Your Own Device (BYOD): Je ontvangt een maandelijkse telefoonvergoeding van €57,50 netto.

 Epassi-vergoeding van €10 per maand die je kunt uitgeven aan persoonlijke behoeften. 

 Lunchfaciliteiten : Voordelige lunch in de kantine en een barista voor verse koffie.

 Zorgverzekering : Profiteer van onze collectieve zorgverzekering.

 Team: 

 Naast het samenwerken met klanten en interne teams ben je dagelijks bezig met het ontwikkelen van nieuwe oplossingen die schaalbaar inzetbaar zijn voor meerdere klanten. Omdat iedere klant andere wensen en doelen heeft werk je met uiteenlopende technologieën; van API-integraties en CDP's tot cloud data platformen, dbt-modellen en marketing automatiseringen.

 Binnen ons interdisciplinaire Data, Tech & Analytics team delen we kennis en toffe projecten, maar ook daarbuiten biedt WPP Media allerlei mogelijkheden om te leren en ontwikkelen. Daarnaast duiken we graag samen het terras op en organiseren activiteiten als boulderen of pubquizes!

 Ben jij de Analytics Engineer die wij zoeken? 
Wil je werken met moderne data-platformen, marketingtechnologie en analytics in een team vol gedreven specialisten? Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Solliciteer direct! 

 Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

About WPP Media

With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.
